NEURAL NET LOG - EDISON TRENT
1553
*PERSONAL ENTRY: I met Lonnigan as planned on Kurile yesterday and we came to an agreement on the price. The plan is to meet on Freeport 7 tomorrow to seal the deal on the ore shipment. If everything works out they'll owe me a million credits. It's the deal of a lifetime.  PERSONAL ENTRY: Well, I did the deal. I'm now the proud owner of over a ton of Boron. I put all my savings into this deal. It's not entirely legal, but here in the Borderworlds, nobody really pays too much attention to this. I've been in contact with a man named Lonnigan, apparently a hired gun representing Samura Heavy Industries. He says his clients might be interested in the shipment.  PERSONAL ENTRY: It's been six weeks since my last entry. Unfortunately, I couldn't find out anything about alien ruins or uncharted systems. Very frustrating. The only thing I've heard was that there's been sightings of strange ships out near Sigma 17. Who knows. The good news is that I've managed to hook up with a captain of a Republican Shipping convoy. He's transporting a large shipment of Boron from Mainz to Honshu, but wants to keep the profits for himself. We agreed to meet on Kurile tomorrow. We'll see, maybe luck is on my side this time.  PERSONAL ENTRY: After two weeks of travel, I finally managed to get to the Sigma system cluster. The trip through the Independent Worlds turned out to be much more dangerous than I thought. I was lucky several times that police patrols happened to be in the area when pirates wanted to blast me out of the stars. Anyway, word has it that there are a number of uncharted systems in this area of space. I will try to find out more information.  PERSONAL ENTRY: I've finally decided to leave Bretonia and to try my luck in the Borderworlds. Despite what Tobias says, I can't sit around Leeds for the rest of my life and fix up other people's ships while more and more alien ruins are being discovered. They say that only 11 percent of the Borderworlds have been charted yet and hundreds of unknown planets are awaiting discovery. I'm starting this personal Neural Net Log to keep track of my travels and adventures.

10913
Nomad Dyson Sphere
10914
A formerly hypothetical structure first described in 1959 A.D. by the physicist Freeman Dyson in a short paper entitled '"Search for Artificial Stellar Sources of Infra-Red Radiation", a Dyson sphere is an artificial hollow sphere of matter around a star designed to capture nearly all of the star's radiated energy for industrial use. The original proposal by Dyson did not go into much detail about how a Dyson sphere would be constructed, focusing instead on the more fundamental issue of how an advanced civilization could expand its energy production to the maximum possible for a given solar system. Such a civilization would be classified as a Phase II civilization under the classification scheme developed by Nikolai Kardashev.

Colonies Rebuild, Chancellor MIA
15264
It's been nearly two weeks since hostilities between Rheinland and the other Houses came to an abrupt end, and peace has settled over the colonies. Despite many lingering questions, government officials remain tight-lipped about what has triggered this sudden change. President Jacobi pardoned the leaders of the military coup against her, who are all recovering from what has been officially called "encephalitic viral infections." Insiders speculate that these infections may be linked to recently discovered evidence of a bizarre mind-control plan initiated by the Chancellor to bring down the major Houses.  Meanwhile, the Chancellor and several of his staff are still missing at this time and together face a long list of charges.  Newly appointed government officials in Rheinland are now looking into recent events and are said to be enlisting even Liberty's help in their investigation.  In other news, LSF Commander Jun'ko Zane and freelancer, Edison Trent, both former enemies of the state, have been granted full pardons and have received the Lone Star for bravery, the highest decoration any individual in the colonies can receive. Though the details of their heroism have been sealed by executive order, they were honored today in a ceremony by President Jacobi, who said, "I, Liberty and the rest of the colonies owe you both a debt of gratitude. It is through your efforts, and people like you, that Sirius will embrace the future.  We salute you."

21925
New objectives in Freelancer are displayed for several seconds at the top of the screen. Objectives are automatically redisplayed every three minutes.  OBJECTIVE COMMANDS: + N key - redisplay an objective + F5 key or star icon at top right - view log of objectives and player journal  KEY SETTINGS: You can customize the default key settings by pressing F1, clicking Options and then choosing Controls.
21930
When you are on a base or planet, a row of icons appears at the top center of your screen that you can use to move to different locations. If you move your mouse over an icon, a tooltip will appear to identify it, and descriptive text will display in the top left corner.  ROOM COMMANDS: + Click on character in room - talk to him or her + Click on room icon (top row, top center of screen) - move to that room + Click on service icon (top center of screen, bottom row) - use services in current room.
21935
PAUSING AND SAVING: Whenever you launch to space, the game updates the current Autosave. As you advance, the game will create progress-point saves and update the Autosave. + F1 key - pause game and view in-game menu + F1 key and click Save Game - save game when on a base or planet + F1 key and click Load Game - load game  STATUS COMMANDS: + F6 key or grid icon at top right - open Nav Map of known locations + F7 key or box icon - view and manipulate inventory + F8 key or person icon - examine player status and reputation + F9 or 'i' icon - read information on current location.
21940
SHIP MOVEMENT CONTROL: FREE FLIGHT: Hold down the left mouse button and move your mouse in the direction you want to turn. MOUSE FLIGHT: Spacebar turns Mouse Flight on. Your ship now turns toward the mouse cursor. To interact with heads-up display, tap spacebar again.  SHIP SPEED CONTROL: W key accelerates your ship; S key decelerates your ship Tab key (held down) activates afterburner speed boost  COMBAT CONTROL: Right mouse click fires active weapons; left mouse click on a target to select it R key selects the closest hostile target.
21945
When objects are destroyed, you can often salvage items from the wreckage.   TRACTORING: + B or chest icon (to the right of speed indicator) - collect all nearby loot + Shift-B - tractor selected loot  LOOTING TIPS: + Commodity loot can be sold on planets and bases for a profit. + Weapons and equipment loot can only be mounted on your ship when you   are landed on a base. + In mineable zones, shoot the small floating asteroids to find valuable   commodities. + In remote locations, shoot abandoned vessels to obtain rare items.
21946
You have just experienced a Trade Lane attack.  While fighting the enemy ships, your ship may take some damage.  RECOVERING FROM DAMAGE: + F or circled-ship icon at bottom right - use shield batteries to help restore   energy to shields + G or wrench icon - repair hull damage with nanobots.

For example, you can complete a mission from a Job Board, mine asteroids, sell loot or trade commodities.  Don't forget - since you don't have jump access, you cannot leave the New York system at this time.

A not insignificant reason for that is that I don't think I'll ever get used to Liberty Ale.

[827 AS] Plasmaball finals canceled over disorder
33397
BAHRENFELD CITY -- 827 AS -- System authorities have canceled the Plasmaball Finals between the Glasgow Ghosts and Hamburg Juggernauts. Mobs affiliated with opposing Imperial and Reformist political blocs have violently clashed across Hamburg in recent weeks, following an attack on Imperial celebrity Fredrick von Albrecht. The Federal Police fear the unruly plasmaball tournament may provide a platform for further escalation. Crowd control police have been deployed around the Championship Stadium as armed rioters protesting the cancellation set fire to vehicles and looted nearby properties.

[834 AS] Final Founder Passes Peacefully
33612
ARRANMORE -- 832 AS -- Ian Carew has died peacefully in his sleep, aged 99. As a teenager, Ian famously hijacked a Bowex freighter during the Founder's Day Revolt. Helping to establish Arranmore, Ian preferred simple custodial tasks at base, keeping morale high with his musical talent and jokes. His stories of the movement's earliest days were an inspiration to many, and will be remembered fondly. Over the decades, Ian saw his comrades-in-arms retired, killed or captured, but insisted he'd live on until "those BMM bastards are gone". Though blind and bound to his wheelchair for his final years, he did indeed survive to see our great victory in Dublin. With his passing, we will cherish the Founders' memories and honor their legacy as a new chapter of Molly history begins.

37690
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Port Tinqueux is the primary spaceport of Planet Marne’s Saint-Dizier Province. The area has historically been notorious for poverty, crime, and discontent. For centuries, the Gallic Royal Police expressed little interest in managing these problems, leaving fertile ground for enormous Gallic Brigand syndicates to establish themselves. As a result, the Brigands operated their own shadowy parallel society, offering security (from themselves) for a price. Driven by these grievances, the people of Saint-Dizier have long held strong republican tendencies, making it one of the key recruiting grounds for The Council during the Second Gallic Civil War.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In Saint-Dizier it is a common sentiment that the Gallic Union is little better than the Kingdom it replaced. This is largely driven by the Treaty of Oerlikon, a sweeping free trade treaty with Rheinland, that has thrown open Gallia’s markets to imported metals and minerals. While GMS had been investing into Marne’s impoverished communities, the shock of cheaper imports has led to uncompetitive mines and refineries being forced out of business. Unemployment in the already impoverished region has soared, as flagship Molybdenum refineries were relocated to Zurich.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Strikes and riots are a frequent occurrence, along with attacks on government assets by Maquis radicals. The Union has so far been reluctant to send in Marines to force open picketed factories and space ports, fearing the move could trigger a second Marne Uprising. Rather, many prominent firebrands have fallen to assassins, leading to accusations being leveled against Unione Corse hitmen. The Maquis are acutely conscious of this, and are actively extracting Dissidents to receive training in insurgency warfare and sabotage elsewhere. The Brigands have also profited handsomely from the chaos, tightening their grip on the area and stamping out vigilante threats to their dominance.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Hidden in an over-mined and exhausted region of the Ardennes Asteroid Field, Montmirail was initially used to smuggle agents to and from Marne. The base was later designated as the primary mustering point for the Council’s fleet in the lead-up to the Second Gallic Civil War. From here, The Council coordinated its efforts during the Battle of Champagne, ultimately driving the Gallic Royal Navy from the system by 721 AGS (804 AS).</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Upon securing Champagne as the capital of the revolution, most Council members relocated to Planet Marne, with only a skeleton crew remaining behind. It remained in this state for almost a decade, slipping from memory until 752 AGS (836 AS), when Maquis operatives began to make repairs. Montmirail is now once again used as a staging point to aid dissidents on Planet Marne, where tensions from the Treaty of Oerlikon have already escalated into violence.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>So far the Maquis have been careful not to draw attention to their newest lair, by avoiding confrontations with the few GMS vessels still eking out a living around the Ardennes’ perimeter.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Appointed as the headquarters of Project COLD LAKE in 823 AS, Leduc pioneered the construction of the first Supergate terminal in over three hundred years. Shrouded in secrecy, the station was placed under guard by both the Liberty Navy and LSF, and supplied by heavily armed convoys.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The project was completed in early 826 AS, connecting to a receiver terminal in Poole and enabling Liberty to break the Siege of New London. Leduc managed the Supergate connection for less than a year before the Poole terminal was catastrophically sabotaged, ending the project. By the end of the year, the encroaching Dark Matter storm posed an extreme risk to any further attempts to reactivate the Supergate program. A general evacuation order was issued, with Leduc coordinating efforts to strip the Supergate of sensitive components for transport to testing sites elsewhere in Liberty. Leduc continued to operate its Bioneural Processor plants up until the point of final shutdown.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

[801 AS] Rheinland Expats Flock to Manhattan
56005
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 801 AS ]]  MANHATTAN -- Rheinland high society is on the move, and Manhattan is the destination of choice. With the economic woes that Rheinland has been experiencing in recent years, many of the colony's finest families are relocating to the center of Sirius. "I can live the life I wish to lead more easily here -- it's a shame, but true," said Gerhardt Schliefner, a newcomer from Stuttgart. Immigrants most commonly cited the uncontrolled crime wave in Rheinland as their primary reason for leaving.

Liberty asserts that its own ships are offered even less protection in the Hamburg system.

Many Stuttgart citizens who believe that there is enough Liberty presence in the system already picketed the Orbital office on Monday.

[827 AS] The Orange Hammer
56479
MALTA -- 827 AS -- Positive news from the Tau campaign have reached Malta's public news channels today. Don David of the Narvaez cartel's ambitious military plan to deal a final blow to the Crayterian menace in the Tau sector that has been plaguing smuggling operations is one step closer to completion. Released military reports state that the Basilica fleet has successfully reached Tau-44 by evading Bretonian defenses around planet Harris. Similarly the Captana fleet has entered the Crayterian stronghold from Tau-23 and dealt with the immediate defenses near the jump hole anomaly.  Even if spirits on Malta are high from the optimistic war reports, military strategists warn that while the operation has been a major success so far, the hardest part is yet to come in the following days. This warning has not stopped Cardamine smugglers as the encircling of Crayterian forces in Tau-44 has opened a new avenue for major profits in the Bretonian underground markets which had been much more difficult to exploit until recently. Jorge Garcia, a leading profits estimator comments with the following "With the current concerns regarding the Liberty drug trade it is for the best to pursue all possible alternatives and war torn Bretonia might prove to be just as lucrative if we seize the opportunity."  But while the Tau campaign sounds promising, an anonymous source has shared with us that the same could not be said about affairs in the Sigmas. With the bulk of our navy's might being focused in the Taus, battlecruiser Tercio and its strike wings in Sigma-17 have been forced to withdraw from the system after an unsuccessful attempt to destroy Cryer Pharmacuticals' research facility in the system. "What is important is that Tercio has not sustained serious damage in the offensive against Atka regardless of the unexpected complications that were met on the way." reassures us the anonymous source who did not disclose more than the fact they participated in the offensive themselves.
56480
[827 AS] Bretonia on the assault!
56481
EDINBURGH -- 827 AS -- The Bretonian Fleets MacDuff, Grimsby and Ark Royal were recently deployed in what has become the largest military operation in Bretonia since the conclusion of the war with Gallia a full year ago. E-Day, as it is being referred to, is the simultaneous entry into Edinburgh via Dublin, Tau 31 and Leeds. It is understood that plans for the invasion have been long in the works, with reports from Gallia of Enclave fleet movements northward being the trigger for the operation being put into motion.  The initial confrontation would occur in the vicinity of the old Planetform base, Perth Station, renamed to Orthez by Gallia in the closing stages of the war. Gallic defenses were concentrated on the Leeds entry point, thought the most likely entry point for any invasion, and the Grimsby fleet would face the heaviest opposition. Enclave defense platforms, similar in design to the platforms that caused such havoc on the Liberty Navy Battleship Ottawa, caused devastating damage to the Battleship Bradford of the Grimsby formation while the rest of the fleet moved to render the defenses inoperable.  The MacDuff, arriving from Tau-31, rushed immediately to the aid of the Grimsby fleet, flanking the Enclave defenders, with the La Riche fleet taking the worst of the fighting for the Enclave. The third fleet, Ark Royal, would be the last to arrive in Edinburgh, being forced to take a conservative approach traversing Dublin, while also being delayed by action from the Sisterion Battlecruiser force. The eventual arrival of the Ark Royal signalled the end of the struggle for the Edinburgh breach point around Perth, as faced with overwhelming odds, the remaining defenders retreated to the second line of defenses around Gaia. La Riche was forced to conduct a rear-guard action that cost the fleet its remaining strength, while the Dax set up in defensive formation around Gaia. The Grimsby, facing the majority of the firepower of the Enclave fleet, coupled with the horrific effects of the defensive emplacements, did not see out the engagement, and surviving members of the fleet were merged into the MacDuff and Ark Royal fleets.  Reports from a BIS Agent speaking under promise of anonymity suggest Issoudun Shipyard and the Sealed Gate that once connected Leeds to Edinburgh, were both being evacuated from Edinburgh. Whether these actions are to protect proprietary technology or something more sinister is yet to be determined. Both were seen as relatively low profile targets, and left Edinburgh as the battle raged.  The Enclave continued to evacuate huge numbers of its population from Planet Gaia, an operation that had been ongoing since the capture of Quillan in Languedoc. Knowing the end was now near as Bretonia had managed to take a foothold in Edinburgh thanks to the sacrifice of the Grimsby, all efforts were being focused on the evacuation. The BAF began to set up siege lines to the east and west of the planet and began to pick at its defences, though further weapon platform emplacements made it implausible to rush in for a full attack. Initial reports suggest the Dax is readying to make its final retreat with the final convoy of Enclave citizens.  According to inside sources close to the Admiralty Board, there has been discussion about pulling both the Ark Royal and MacDuff out of Edinburgh following the operations completion owing to security concerns and the inability to maintain proper supply to Edinburgh without a jump-gate connection being re-established. This leaves the Edinburgh system in a state of lawlessness, and it is feared that the Mollys and other dissident groups will use the population of Gaia as a recruitment center for those who hold ill will towards Bretonia.  News of the relatively good progress made in the invasion has resulted in a sharp rise in the stock markets, as it is hoped that quelling the Enclave threat in Edinburgh will result in safer transit through Leeds, and even reclamation of LD-14 Uranium reserves, once thought hopeless due to the proximity to Edinburgh.
56482
[827 AS] Dark matter storm forces evacuation
56483
FREEPORT 14 -- 827 AS -- The epicenter of the dark matter storm, Freeport 14, the last remaining station in Alberta, has been under lock-down since the storm engulfed the entirety of the system. Few vessels have been granted permission to access the station in hopes of reducing traffic, and the already heavy strain on the station's resources. The storm has been the cause of destruction of a number of stations within the system already, with Freeport 14 only standing strong due to the early preparation and structural reinforcements.  While the station seems to be in good health, a number of problems have since arisen, including the lack of medical supplies, a failing in waste management systems, a shortage of fresh water, and a lack of a steady supply of food. Several small scale evacuations have already taken place, with many having ignored the recommendation to leave before it is too late.  The Praia is on route, and a mandatory evacuation of the station is now underway. This evacuation fleet will be the last to reach Freeport 14 before the life support is shut down in an attempt to preserve resources in hopes the station can be salvaged. This evacuation is a last attempt to save as many lives as possible before the storm becomes too strong for even the most hardened vessels to pass through.  Onboard Freeport 14 is a picture of panic as the last preparations are taking place for the evacuation, with many remaining people being only told to take what they can carry to save space on the vessels coming to retrieve them. [828 AS] Birds of a feather
56551
STUTTGART -- 828 AS -- The enemies of Synth Foods in the Houses of Rheinland and Kusari have always had near identical motivations. Both wish to oust the Liberty corporation from what they perceive as their land, and it seems the groups have decided to act in concert to do just that. Attacks against the food giant's vessels have multiplied and are now being launched on an interhouse scale, likely in retaliation for Synth Foods' operations recovering in Rheinland while making inroads into the Kusari market too. It remains to be seen how this united Farmers Alliance will impact affairs on the wider stage, with the security forces of both Houses already strained by internal conflict and crime.

60207
Docking Ring
60208
A docking ring is a piece of orbiting technology that, through the use of super strong crystalline polymers and frictionless bearings, assists the smooth atmospheric entry of any interstellar vessel that has the ability to land. Invented in 130 AS by Valhalla Research (later renamed Ageira Technologies), these 'orbital elevators' almost completely negate the cost of boosting people or materials out of a planetary gravity well. Docking rings revolutionized exploration and industry almost overnight, opening up entire systems for commercial exploration and exploitation.   Ageira licenses this technology to the other houses, who in turn agree to design all ships (except for special exploratory and survey vessels), to work with the docking ring system.   WARNING: Do not approach a planet and attempt a landing without using the docking ring.
60209
Jump Gate
60210
A Jump Gate is a conveyance technology that allows instantaneous travel between two distinct points in space using technology pioneered by Ageira Technologies and built by Deep Space Engineering in 130 AS According to the annual Ageira Technologies Shareholder Report, 'Jump Gate technology is designed to gather and amplify certain permeable tendencies in real-space and connect them to other congruent points elsewhere in the sector, while still maintaining the structural integrity and stability of the channel created by this process and of the object passing through it.'  Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering continue to survey other potential jump point candidates and expect to provide connections with other areas further and further away as their research continues.
60211
Jump Hole
60212
***GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY DETECTED*** Magnetic and gravimetric readings consistent with a 'jump hole'.  Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.

Trade Lane Ring
60246
Trade lanes are used for superluminal travel within a system. Trade lanes must be entered from their origin point, usually located near key industrial, military, or civilian bases.  The first Trade Lane was established through a joint venture between the corporations now known as Deep Space Engineering and Ageira Technologies in the year 280 AS. By 350 AS, most of Liberty space was crisscrossed by Trade Lanes. Through financing from Interspace Commerce, the Trade Lane network was rapidly extended into the other colonies, helping to create a truly sector-wide economy. Trade lanes are the fastest and safest method of transporting goods and personnel within and between the colonies. Plans to expand the Trade Lanes to connect interests in the independent territories outside of the colonies are pending.

When the Hispania drifted within range of a red dwarf system, conflict aboard the ship escalated, and about half of the surviving colonists decided to take escape pods, chancing their survival on the promise of a habitable world. The remaining half coaxed the damaged vessel onwards to its eventual destination in the Omicron Alpha system, arriving some time in the year 41 AS Upon their arrival, the crew discovered a planet capable of supporting human life in orbit of the primary star. The Hispania's passengers named the planet Malta -- a harsh place of acidic oceans, gray skies, and vast plains covered in a species of tall, thin, orange grass. Taking whatever equipment they could salvage from the crippled Hispania, they left the hulk in orbit of Malta and began to make a home for themselves on Malta.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Eventually the Outcasts -- as they came to think of themselves -- began a limited exploration of their home system. After making a number of genetic scans of critically ill pilots, the doctors made a startling and disturbing discovery. Their genetic code had been altered considerably. The Outcast human DNA was found to contain strands identical to that of the orange grasses that covered the planet -- from which the drug Cardamine was derived. Trace amounts were present in everything on the planet, in their food, their water, even the very air. Once pilots made lengthier journeys away from Malta, their bodies went into shock, followed by death.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Outcasts were now truly separated from the rest of humanity -- changed so that they could never expand beyond the planet on which they had landed. Over time, their knowledge of Cardamine improved, and the Outcasts learned that distributing it in a highly concentrated dose causes extreme euphoria. When they finally encountered the rest of the Houses in the seventh century, a new strategy emerged. The Outcasts would deliver the poison that would rot the other Houses from the inside out and grow rich from the profits of their trade.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The planet's crust is largely devoid of usable metallic elements, with a few notable exceptions, namely at the heart of her largest continent, and highly unusual deposits of metallic Copper on the ocean floor. Malta's architecture is a largely low-hung and flat, one-story affair in the rural areas; cities are an expression of extremes, built almost entirely in the rare hilly regions of the planet. There is little at ground-level, except starports; most structures are built both deep into the ground and into massive towers that reach towards the sky, constructed yet again as to mimic the textures of the ground. 67000
[834 AS] Cadet fraternity disciplined over hazing
67001
WEST POINT -- 834 -- West Point command staff have issued a reprimand against a popular cadet fraternity after being implicated in the hazing of new applicants. The practice has been prohibited since the death of Christine Belton 33 years ago, however it is widely understood that hazing at the academy has continued by imposing bizarre, dangerous or humiliating tasks on potential aspirants. The most recent incident was detected when the Mississippi Training Facility’s transponder was overwritten to broadcast as the Battleship Missouri. Investigation revealed cadets training aboard to be the culprits, who had pulled the prank in an attempt to impress fraternity leaders.

[828 AS] Camp Oku Slaughter!
335319
NEW TOKYO -- 828 AS -- Last night a surprise attack was launched on Camp Oku on Tomioka by the Blood Dragons. The ensuing firefight reportedly lasted for over eight hours in which the local Kusari Military Forces and Samura Security details were hard pressed to defend the camp.   Rear-Admiral Kato Masanori confirmed the broad facts of what happened but declined to comment further on the details which have surfaced from Samura sources.   Samura spokesperson Pak Daewon said this morning that "The terrorist group known as the Blood Dragons launched a devastating and violent attack on Camp Oku in the early hours of the night. They proceeded to slaughter their way through the camp, targeting our unarmed civilian personnel as well as our security detail. Our employees went above and beyond their calling in those stressful hours fighting against these barbarians."   Samura has since requested that the Kusari government deploy more forces to Tomioka to finally evict the Blood Dragons from their positions. It has also requested that a special licence be given to Samura to expand its security detail further making it more comparable to a military arm than corporate security.   There has so far been no official comment from the Kusari government at this time in regards to the situation on Tomioka or for what Samura has asked for.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Pecos is a large moon composed of rock and ice, with a 37-year orbital cycle of freezing and thawing caused by Planet Salina's intense tidal forces. The Independent Miners Guild (IMG) established a small mining colony in 802 AS, shortly before Barrier Gate opened. The IMG discovered large deposits of Copper deep within the icy crust, which was extracted in spartan subterranean mining colonies. Since then, local mining has gradually declined in favour of orbital operations in the Sierra Vista Nebula. Despite this, Pecos remains an important refining centre, processing harvested Copper Ore and Hydrogen. Traditionally the Guild has shipped Pecos' exports to Tau-31 or Manchester for distribution by Gateway Shipping.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 817 AS, after the Gallic conquest of Tau-44, the Crayter Republic leased large tracts of land from the IMG to temporarily house their fleeing civilian population. The moon is entirely unsuitable for agriculture or large-scale settlement, and the refugee population could only be sustained through a constant stream of expensive imports from Liberty. Prior to the Crayterian arrival, there were rarely more than a few hundred residents at any time. The relationship between the refugees and heavily outnumbered Miners became strained and suspicious following the annexation of Aland Shipyard in 826 AS, in which the Crayter Republic had supported the Bretonian action.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>As the colonization of Yuma progressed, the population of Pecos dwindled, with the last Crayter representatives being expelled by 834 AS. As the last refugee habitat became an abandoned ghost town, the local population returned back to the low hundreds. The following year, Pecos was hit by an energy blast from the Jericho Incident. Fortunately, the moon's orbital period ensured Planet Salina bore the brunt of the impact, while the underground mining colonies were further insulated from the residue blast. Despite this, significant damage has been caused to local electronics. The IMG have resolved to persevere and continue work, despite Jericho's proximity and the risk of further incidents.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Roleplay improves the game experience by creating an immersive universe that lets all players entertain through creativity.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To roleplay means playing the role of a character living in Sirius, whose biography you defined. Their personality may differ largely from your own. Be a hero, anti-hero, leader, disciple, back-stabbing crook, gung-ho soldier, artificial intelligence, money-groping capitalist, weirdo, multi-faceted and complex, or simple-minded. If you want to roleplay personalities similar to Han Solo, Jean-Luc Piccard, or Orillion, please do but use different names to stay immersive and original.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To keep role play realistic and fair, you shouldn't do things that your character realistically wouldn't do, or wouldn't know. For example, don't be a Liberty Navy pilot who defends pirates against the forces of the law. Don't use knowledge you acquired on your Corsair character to bust an artifact smuggler on your Police character.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Roleplay consists of spoken words and of actions such as firing weapons. Be tolerant of players who enjoy either the story-telling or the space combat game aspects more than you. If you favor talking over shooting, it's up to you to avoid situations where you're destined to get shot at. If you enjoy combat, it's up to you to respect the required roleplay context and server rules. Space is both fascinating, and dangerous.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591835
Trading
591836
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Trading is a straight-forward method to increase wealth. Most players have one or more trade ships they transfer credits to other ships from (see "Cash Transfer" for info). Ships with larger holds bring larger profits per trip, but have less maneuverability and therefore more vulnerability to pirates. Be sure to read your ID so you don't violate its cargo size restrictions. Enter /stuck if you are stuck in a base or asteroids with a large ship.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>By landing on unexplored stations and planets, you'l learn about more trade routes (seen by clicking the "Trade Routes" icon in the commodity information). A good way to maximize your profits is to join trade factions who'll assist you in finding profitable routes and the best ships.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Armed escorts and scouts can protect you against pirates, but if you're still robbed of credits or cargo, quench your thirst for revenge by placing a bounty (see Bounty Boards on discoverygc.com/forums). Most of the time, sweet-talking yourself out of a stick-up or paying the pirate are cheaper alternatives than trying to run. Disconnecting from the server to escape piracy will result in sanction, as piracy and antagonists are an important part of the game and role play.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Trade runs are a great time to chat with potential business partners, read all help topics, or use LEFT-TAB + RETURN for windowed mode and visit discoverygc.com. Trading in windowed mode works best if you set the game resolution lower than your desktop resolution in the game launcher. Browsing the internet while playing may cause severe lag and disconnections on low bandwidth connections.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591837
Mining
591838
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Shooting the small moving asteroids with mining lasers in areas marked yellow by the navmap's pickax symbol will generate mineral ore in cargo holds. Gas is mined by shooting moving particles in the exhaust of gas mining facilities. Using mining lasers on a mining ship with mining IDs will boost efficiency and generate more ore per hit. The more parallel mining turrets you have, the bigger the bonus. Mining factions will be glad to help you set up an efficient miner if you join them.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>If you target another player's ship within 1k distance while mining, the ore is automatically transferred to that ship's cargo hold (unless your IDs are incompatible). Working as a miner/hauler team with one miner and one large transport is the most time-efficient way to make credits.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ore drop rates also depend on the individual ID and field characteristics. Some yellow-marked fields no longer yield ore, so ask for help from experienced miners if you don't get any for unknown reasons. More information can be found in the Discovery Mining Guide at discoverygc.com.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591839
Cash Transfer
591840
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>In addition to the trade icon that appears when a ship is within 1k distance, console commands will help you transfer cash to ships of other players, as well as to your own.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>/givecash SHIPNAME AMOUNT - Transfers credits to SHIPNAME. The beneficiary doesn't need to be online at the time of the transfer.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>/drawcash NAME CASHCODE AMOUNT - Draws cash from another ship using a cashcode</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>/set cashcode - Sets the cashcode so you (or other players who know the code) can draw cash from your current ship</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591841
Reputation
591842
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Your reputation affects whether bases let you dock and buy equipment, bar characters talk to you, NPCs attack you, the color of radar contacts, and your own Identify Friend-Foe (IFF) tag. Other players see your IFF tag in front of your name in their targeting computer.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>View your reputation with the factions you've met using the man-shaped symbol in the top right corner or the F8 key. Killing NPCs (not players) lowers your rep with their faction, while fulfilling missions for them raises it. Grouping with players while they accomplish missions affects your rep even if you don't actively partake. Raising reputation with a faction also raises it with their allies and lowers it with enemies.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A very friendly reputation is needed to join a faction by buying its ID. Having a faction's ID mounted will force the rep of its enemies/allies to friendly/hostile when you launch. You'll adopt the faction's IFF when friendliest to them. The faction name will flash yellow once you've adopted their IFF, and players will see you as affiliated with it. Typing /droprep will drop the reputation of your current IFF, and replace it with the next best friendly faction.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591843
Power Core
591844
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>When you buy equipment or ships manufactured by factions that don't match your ID, your power core will lose efficiency. This is done to uphold realism and variety, to keep for example Gallic Royal Navy from using equipment built exclusively by their Bretonian enemies. Check the Tech Chart at lh.discoverygc.com/software/compatibility or mount/unmount equipment to find out working combinations.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591845
COMBAT
591846
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>You can improve your ship with armor, weapons, shields, and thrusters, but skill and tactics determine the outcome of most fights. Even the best equipped battleship can be helpless against small craft that are too agile to hit and too fast to pursue or to escape from. It's recommended to train combat early on using small craft to get a grasp of tactics and game mechanics. You can train fighting against other players in the out-of-roleplay Connecticut system (type /conn while docked to get there and /return to get back to Sirius), and practice the basic skills explained in the Help System against NPCs.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Learn to dodge fire by using thruster (TAB key), randomly changing direction, and strafing (A and D). Quick-docking with Trade Lanes and Jump Gates (fly to the right spot before pressing F3) will save you from receiving damage in lengthy docking sequences. Cruise disruptors keep enemies from escaping, but also detonate nearby mines, torpedoes, and missiles.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The better pilot wins most fights, not the biggest ship. Building skill requires practice, and there are many tricks that experienced pilots are willing to teach players who work with them. Combat can also be learned through written and video tutorials available at discovery.com/forums (look in the pinned "A Pretty Helpful Tutorial Database" post in the Tutorials sub-forum).</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591847
Survival
591848
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The most important asset for survival is to know how to not get hit by enemy shots. In order to dodge projectiles, change your vector often by:</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-turning while thrusting (hold down the TAB key to thrust and move the mouse from one edge of the screen to another in a circular pattern)</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-strafing in alternate directions (move horizontally using A and D keys or vertically using customized controls)</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-altering speed with thrust and reverse-thrust (useful in some situations but dangerous in others)</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Pressing TAB to thrust will make your turns more effective at dodging fire, but keep an eye on your thruster's energy so you don't become a sitting duck when it runs out. Learning to Engine-Kill will help you conserve its energy (see "Engine Kill" help). Keep in mind that dodging fire becomes easier with greater distance and slower projectiles. Turning (mouse movements) while thrusting is the most effective way to dodge when you aren't shooting at an enemy yourself, but strafing lets you avoid enemy fire while still aiming and firing in front of you at the same time. Using reverse thrust and making a sharp turn at the same time can shake an enemy off your tail, but can get you hit even more when done in the wrong situation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>It's best to practice survival techniques in places guarded by hostile NPCs, so you know how to survive when it really counts. The more agile and smaller your ship is, the better it is at dodging fire, which is why small craft often survive longer than large ones in Player vs Player fights (see the "Tactics" help). Light Fighters are nearly impossible to hit when flown by skilled pilots, while Heavy Fighters, Very Heavy Fighters, and bombers are balanced for agility, firepower, and hit points.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Purchasable armor upgrades will multiply your ship's base armor by a certain factor so it can survive more hits. Be sure to mount the armor in an engine shop on a station so you don't lose it when you die. Armor upgrades make the nanobot repair (used by pressing the G key) more effective by the same factor. Use of shield batteries (used by pressing the F key) is best saved for moments when your shield is completely down and you know you'll unavoidably get hit more before it can regenerate, and similar emergencies. Use your nanobots as soon as you took damage to hull, but save shield batteries for dire situations because shields regenerate with time while hull doesn't. Learning skills like quick-docking with lanes, gates, and stations will not only get you hit less while docking, but also allows for faster travel while trading (see "Quick Dock" help).</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591849
Quick Dock
591850
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Docking sequences with lanes, gates, stations, and planets can be made nearly instantaneous if docking is initiated by pressing the F3 key while being in the right place.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The optimal location for Trade Lane docking is close before the center of the lane ring that points towards the direction you want to travel. The red/green lights in the corners indicate the direction of the ring. The optimal docking location for Jump Gates is shortly before the small round opening in the closed "claws". Jump holes are best docked with while you are directly in them, except certain large slow ships for which the best moment to press F3 is shortly before entering the hole.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Stations commonly have quick dock points near airlocks (grey squares) or tower lights. Planets have their quick dock points, which unlike docking rings also service large ships, at the mooring fixtures near the rings. Player Owned Bases (POBs) have quick dock points slightly above and below the central docking hangar.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591851
Gun Stats
591852
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Consider all the attributes when choosing the right gun or turret. Guns which excel in one attribute generally have deficits in the others.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Speed: Faster projectiles increase the likelihood to hit the target, because it leaves less time for it to change vector and avoid the shot.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Re-fire Rate: Higher fire rate raises your hit rate on small targets, leaving them less time to regenerate shields.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Range: Being able to fire at longer ranges gives you an agility advantage if your target is too large and slow to dodge shots even at a distance.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Energy Efficiency (damage per energy): Higher energy efficiency lets you deal more damage before your energy is drained.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Hull Damage per Second (hull damage x fire rate): Often thought to be the most important characteristic of a gun. But also consider that slow projectile speed will make a lot of your shots miss small agile targets, and that energy efficiency matters especially when you drain your power to zero by firing continually. Hull damage is only dealt if the target's shield is down.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Shield Damage: Certain types of guns deal heavy damage to shields and almost none to hull. These guns are useful to raise energy efficiency by splitting weapons into "Shield Buster" and "Hull Buster" groups that are selected depending on whether the target's shields are up or down (see the "Weapon Group" help).</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591853
Weapon Group
591854
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Splitting weapons into groups can improve tactics, energy efficiency, and aim.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To create weapons groups activated by number keys (above the letter keys), open the F1 menu and select "Options", then "Controls". Then go to "User Interface" and scroll down to assign the number keys to "Activate Weapons Group" 0 through 9. The number keys will now activate weapons groups on all your characters and all accounts, so this step is needed only once on every computer you use.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To assign or un-assign certain weapons to a group, press the number key to select the group, then click on the weapons in the lower right window to activate (green) or de-activate (light blue) them. Pressing this number key will now de-activate or activate weapons according to what you assigned to the group. Be sure to have weapon group 1 activated while docking (or dying), or group 1 and the active group will be over-written because of a game bug.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The most common use of weapons groups in both small craft like fighters/bombers ("snubs") as well as capital ships like cruisers and battleships ("caps") is to separate guns that do more damage to shields and hull (see the "Gun Choice" help). This allows you to quickly switch weapon type depending on whether the target's shield is up or down. A widespread way to do this is to have group 1 with both "hullbusters" and "shieldbusters" active (quickly takes down enemy shields when your energy reserve is high), group 2 "hullbuster"-only (used when the enemy's shield is down) and group 3 "shieldbuster"-only (used when the enemy's shield is up and your energy reserve is low).</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In multi-turret capital ships, you'll also want to separate guns with fast projectile speed (for defense against close fast moving targets) and guns with slow speed but high damage output and range (for heavily armored slow moving targets at greater distance). Having guns with different projectile speed activated at the same time will make the targeting cross-hair inaccurate.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591855
Engine Kill
591856
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>One of the most important techniques used by skilled pilots is to shut off the engine and let the ship drift freely.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Its uses include saving thruster energy, firing multiple Cruise Disruptors (CDs) while maintaining cruise speed, out-maneuvering your opponent in dog-fights, and firing without getting in the way of your wingmen in group fights.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Go to the F1 Options/Controls Menu and assign Engine Kill to a key that is easy to reach without moving your hand from the A,S,D, and W keys (mostly used are X, Y, or Z depending on your keyboard). Engine kill only works when "goto" (F2) or "dock" (F3) aren't activated. Press the Engine Kill key and you should hear the sound of the engine being turned off. Then press and release the thrust or strafe keys, and you should keep drifting in the same direction even after releasing the trust/strafe key, and even when turning your ship in another direction with the mouse. Pressing the Accelerate or Decelerate keys turns the engine back on.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>You can use Engine Kill to move at thrust speed for an unlimited amount of time without draining thruster energy, by keeping your engine off and tapping the thrust key from time to time. You can also dodge enemy fire doing this, if you turn in different directions while pressing thrust.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Engine Kill also works while cruising, which is useful for firing cruise disruptors (CDs) at a fleeing target without having to slow down. However, being hit by a cruise disruptor yourself also nullifies your engine kill, making it an effective counter to many Engine Kill tactics.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Killing your engine to keep drifting in one direction while turning your ship around is a good way to get an enemy into your gun sights during 1 on 1 fights. This technique also lets you lose pesky NPCs because they stop following you when you do it for long enough. Keep in mind that you're easy to hit when drifting in a straight line, so avoid doing it at the wrong moment.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>When done right, engine kill allows you to out-turn your opponents in a way that keeps you out of their gun sights. Check the PvP Tutorials on discovery.gc and practice this technique if you want to become a dog-fighting ace.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591857
Cruise-Disrupt
591858
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>In addition to the main function of keeping an enemy from fleeing, cruise disruptors can be used as offensive and defense weapons. They detonate mines and missiles within their blast range, and can thus detonate them prematurely. This technique is sometimes called "Counter Cruise Disrupting" or CCD. CD hits also keep an enemy from cloaking as long as the cloak is still charging, and from using Engine Kill.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Cruise Disruptors have excellent homing capabilities, and therefore dropping multiple Counter Measures (CMs) is recommended when trying to escape them.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>CDs with large blast radius are more effective at stopping large ships, but tend to make NPCs hostile to you more if they get caught in the blast. Using a Mosquito CD which has a small blast radius can help avoid making friendly NPCs hostile.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
591859
Tactics
591860
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Fighting experienced players is very different from fighting NPCs which only have limited artificial intelligence. The most important lesson to learn is that owning the biggest, best armored, and best-equipped ship won't automatically mean you will win or survive. The most likely winners are players who correctly assess the situation, who know the limitations of their ships, and who possess the right skills and strategies.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Fast and agile craft will always be able to escape without being killed by slower ships, unless they make the mistake of coming too close. It's therefore recommended you become a halfway decent fighter/bomber pilot before you get an expensive ship of which you don't know the capabilities and limitations. Even if you prefer large ships, learning to fight "caps" in "snubs" will teach you the basic combat dynamics early on. Learn techniques like dodging fire and grouping weapons. Observe and train how every snub or cap weapon is used most effectively.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A good way to quickly learn useful aspects of the game and have fun with friends is to join an existing player faction. Player factions commonly have prefixes (tags) like "Order|" or "K'Hara-" in front of their names, so feel free to ask tagged ships if their faction is recruiting. You can find more information about player factions at discoverygc.com/forum, in the "Faction" section.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Don't forget that the goal of the game isn't to win every fight, but to have fun. Disrespecting players (not role play characters) and poor role play will often result in people wanting to see you explode to get rid of you. But don't expect to not be attacked just because your own role-play is friendly or "good", as conflict and combat are important elements of role-play. Making friends instead of enemies (in and out of roleplay) is the best tactic for achieving a good gaming experience.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Signals identical to those originating from Gammu and the Technocrats were detected on the planet's surface. These signals immediately piqued the interest of Corsair and Core scouts. However, it soon became apparent that they represented only a limited planetary presence—presumably the result of the landing of a few survivors after the Battle of Gammu. Through this, the Order was able to deduce that most of the Nomads living on Moros are in a state of hibernation, possibly to reduce the amount of energy necessary to sustain themselves and thereby put less strain on the planet's core.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Planet New Paris
592854
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 12,418 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 5.95 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Terrestrial</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -66°C to 68°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.28 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>New Paris was the first planet colonized by the Gallic Sleeper Ship's arrival in 84 AS (0 AGS). Ecologically, the world was similar to Earth's Carboniferous period. Vast forests cover the equatorial and moderate regions but only a few large animal species in habit them. Oxygen concentration on New Paris is similar to human-inhabited Earth, hovering at 24 percent. Unlike the Carboniferous period, which had an Oxygen content of almost 40 percent, therefore large insect species didn't develop, leaving room for smaller amphibians and small avian dinosaurs to evolve. Cold continental areas were sparsely inhabited and had no large flora. Oceanic wildlife is extremely rich with a wide variety of species; most do not bear resemblance to any known Earth animals. The planet's climate was similar to Earth, with temperatures of 60°C at the equator and dropping below -60°C at the poles.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>New Paris has undergone several periods of development, starting with numerous isolated colonies. Soon afterwards, large cities evolved from these, and food demand forced them to exploit huge areas of land to plant crops and raise animals brought from Earth. In many areas, indigenous wildlife was fully replaced with domesticated fauna and flora from Earth. Rapid industrial growth resulted in severe pollution that still affects certain areas of the planet. Circa 200 AGS, the planet's population neared 5 million and large urban centers emerged in moderate climates near natural harbors. Those centers were named after old Paris districts.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The population grew steadily and reached 1 billion by 600 AGS. Millions relocated off-world, with massive relocation campaigns taking place to populate worlds with huge resource deposits and industrial capacity. Apart from the relocation programs, many people left New Paris to find a better standard of living and capturing their inner pioneer spirit. Sadly, New Paris gradually became the most expensive planet to live in all of Gallia.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ecology issues forced the removal of heavy industry away from New Paris to space stations in Ile-de-France and beyond. The few remaining ancient factories now serve as museums displaying impressive industrial landmarks similar to 21st century Earth. Currently, the planet is considered to be one of the most comfortable places to live in all of Gallia. Offices of the Royal Government and Royal Chancellery, as well as the High Courts and the Parliament, were located on New Paris.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>By the end of the Second Gallic Civil War, the Council's fleet reached New Paris and prepared for a final battle against the remains of the Royal Navy's home fleet. By that point, the King, his court retainers, closest followers and various nobles had already evacuated and were on their way to the Gallic Hebrides. Thus cooler heads prevailed and the Royal Navy chose to surrender, and a ceasefire was issued throughout Gallia. The historic seat of the Gallic monarchy was now at the Council's mercy.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>However, higher planet side living standards, proximity to the Monarchy and decades of ardent propaganda ensured that the Parisians had a low opinion of the Council and its ideology. Consequently, the provisional government of Ile-de-France declined to join the newly-formed Republic, which in turn wasn't willing to start a new era with a bloodbath.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Instead, New Paris declared itself an autonomous state despite possessing little to defend itself. The reason behind this decision ties into Ile-de-France's considerable strategic import. Namely, significant industrial and shipbuilding capacity and enormous agricultural production capabilities ensure that the system could be entirely self-sufficient. Also Ile-de-France is located at the heart of the Gallic lane network, guaranteeing it freedom of navigation and the ability to shut down trade in any of the Confederate states by deactivating the corresponding gates.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>This also made Ile-de-France the most logical choice for a neutral meeting ground between the leaders and representatives of all Gallic states. This summit, known as the Parisian Assembly, is where the Confederacy was born, out of need for Gallia to remain united against internal divisions and against external threats. It was also the Assembly that outlawed weapons of mass destruction throughout Gallia, banning the Royal Navy's WMDs and largest ships from its space.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Nowadays, the Assembly hosts regular meetings of Gallia's elite. Each constituent state of the Confederacy has permanent representation on New Paris, and some Sirian entities already have their own embassies planet side. The Assembly presides over all aspects of Confederate-level governing; funding specific projects, maintaining infrastructure, allocating supplies, regulating tariffs and providing arbitration in disputes between the Gallic states. In return, said states are required to provide support to Ile-de-France, in the form of taxes, manpower and ships. These contributions are used to fuel both the Gendarmerie and the new Confederate Defense Force.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

It initially served as the vanguard of the new formed Independent Worlds fleet. After Rheinland destroyed the Jump Gates leading to their space in 819 AS, the Alma was stationed in orbit of Planet Atka, where it protected Liberty's nascent terraforming project from MND sabotage and pirate attacks. At the end of the Hudson War in 823 AS, the Alma was withdrawn to Norfolk Shipyard for substantial refitting and maintenance.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>With the fall of Magellan to the Gallic Royal Navy in 824 AS, the battleship was pushed forward into California as a part of the home fleet, supporting the battleships Concord and Rio Grand. This led to a final confrontation with the Carcassone fleet near Los Angeles in 826 AS, in which Gallic battleship surrendered upon learning of the collapse of the Gallic Kingdom. After several years garrisoning California, the Alma was tasked with the pacification and then annexation of Pennsylvania in 830 AS. Leading Operation Pesticide, the Alma notably destroyed the Zoner Carrier Pinnacle before deploying its Marine contingent to occupy Planet Erie's Lake City.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Since then, the Alma has earned an extremely capable reputation for its systematic suppression of Erie Militant attacks. This made the Alma a high profile target for Kusari when planning their first-strike operation in mid 836 AS. The Alma deployed to respond to an attack on Titusville Refinery, expecting to find Militant raiders due to signal jamming. Instead, it was ambushed and severely damaged by Kusari special forces. Fighting a retreat back to Erie's defense grid, the ship is now undergoing emergency damage control to extinguish fires and stabilize the reactor. As news spreads that the Alma has been incapacitated, Militant, Liberty Rogue, and Xeno attacks across the system have sharply escalated.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Battlecruiser Lehigh
594022
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Interdictor</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: </TEXT><TRA data="0x0000FF01" mask="-1"/><TEXT>CLASSIFIED</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0x00000000" mask="-1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT>ARMAMENT: </TEXT><TRA data="0x0000FF01" mask="-1"/><TEXT>CLASSIFIED</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
594023
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Battlecruiser Lehigh was deployed in 822 AS, shortly after the end of the Hudson War. Designed as an LSF deep space raider, its original mission brief was to cross the vast spaces between Bering and Hamburg to disrupt commerce, applying pressure for Rheinland to accept peace terms. Instead, its first assignments included tours of Pennsylvania and later Kansas to suppress pirate and Hellfire Legion activity. It later participated in the Scouring of Bering, working with the Battleship Concord to rout the newly formed Liberty Insurgency. During the Vespucci Campaign, the Lehigh gained a bloody reputation for its actions in Magellan, where it blocked the retreat of defeated Insurgency survivors -- allegedly under standing orders to take no prisoners.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>It was then deployed to Colorado to guard the locked Kepler Jump Gate, although some allege the LSF were actually scouting paths through the system’s dark matter storm to find Jump Holes into Kusari. This tour came to an end in 834 AS, when LSF spy satellites detected a large hyperspace pulse in Ontario. Due to its deep space capabilities, the Lehigh was dispatched to urgently investigate. The battlecruiser secured a defensive zone near Ontario’s abandoned Jump Gate, protecting the construction ship Robert Peary as it carried out emergency reactivation repairs. The Lehigh’s patrols confirmed Planet Sudbury was source of the initial hyperspace reading, and later obtained scans of further pulses when an enormous beam was fired from the planet into deep space.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Lehigh's deployment came to an ignoble end in 835 AS, when it was attacked by a massed swarm of Xeno fighters, led by the Liberty Rose -- later identified through hull scans as the lost Battleship Alabama. While the LSF task force inflicted brutal losses on the Xenos, the battlecruiser was eventually overwhelmed by weight of numbers and badly damaged. Forced to retreat, the Lehigh underwent emergency repairs at Norfolk Shipyard and final fittings for a modular Cloaking Device at Chadwick Station. The battlecruiser was preparing for launch at the time of Kusari's surprise attack, allowing it to lead the Zone-21 garrison in a counter-attack on the Kusari fleet. The LSF strike force received commendations for the rapid destruction of the Liner Courageous that appeared to be anchoring the attacker's exit point.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Lehigh is now temporarily overseeing the preparation of Baltimore's defenses. It is expected to soon deploy to battle on special assignment.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Sunbucks Coffee is the official concession of Liberty Police Inc., expertly blended in partnership with elite Synth Foods Flavor Engineers. It is popular among commuting spacers who need a fix of something approaching caffeine -- Sunbucks New York aboard Fort Bush has long been the brand's busiest franchise.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The imposition of the Baltimore Defense Grid initially led to fears among franchisees that passing trade would collapse, however the shortfall has more than been made up for by an influx of overworked shipyard engineers and sleep-deprived Navy and LSF pilots.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>MENU:</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>- Sunbucks Coffee and Donuts, $500</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

This displaced the Liner Tokushima, which had recently been structurally completed, but had not yet received the luxury interior amenities that characterizes the Shukensha class. Lacking alternate facilities to finish this work, the Renzu Corporation prepared to mothball the ship for the duration of the war.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Instead, the Kusari government offered a lucrative contract to ship interned Liberty citizens aboard Deshima Station to Bretonia. Post-war budget cuts to the Navy nearly saw the ship broken up for scrap while it was still on the stocks. Only the intervention of the LSF allowed the ship's completion. The Liberty Security Force provided funding for the remaining construction of Chickamauga after the Navy agreed it would be launched as an LSF ship upon completion. Even this proved overly ambitious, as a change of LSF leadership lead to the nearly completed Chickamauga being cut from the LSF's budget just six months after the signing of the agreement. Chickamauga's limbo was finally broken when a congressional budgetary inquiry found that it would cost the government more to break up the ship at Norfolk than it would to finish its construction. And so, Battlecruiser Chickamauga was the first Interdictor launched post-Gallic War.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Chickamauga came outfitted with only the most basic of Navy systems aboard, with none of the LSF upgrades its sisters Lehigh and Tuscaloosa had. With LSF leadership ambivalent on how to utilize the new ship, and no extra budget to outfit the battlecruiser for reconnaissance work, it was decided to assign Chickamauga to Chadwick Station in Zone-21 where it would serve as guard ship for the next six years. Over its service, Chickamauga has acted as both a training ship for new LSF combat pilots and a stalwart guard of Liberty's secrets deeper within Zone-21. In 833, it received modest upgrades to keep communications and weapons systems up to date, but no dedicated LSF upgrades were ever proposed for the ship.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 836, when Kusari launched a surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard, Chickamauga was one of the first ships to respond. Chickamauga's fighter wing, mostly consisting of LSF ensigns, was sent forward to join the defense immediately, and Chickamauga put its pristine engines to good use and joined Missouri's battle group. Chickamauga arrived too late to stop the Hamamatsu's final maneuver, but the ship's weapons fire and fighters joined in the fight to chase off the remaining Kusari forces into the Badlands. Following the attack, it has returned to Zone-21 and has been joined by the LSF cruiser Tallapoosa to serve as the anchor of Liberty's Zone-21 defense force.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Interdictor Block Ia</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: </TEXT><TRA data="0x0000FF01" mask="-1"/><TEXT>CLASSIFIED</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0x00000000" mask="-1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT>ARMAMENT: </TEXT><TRA data="0x0000FF01" mask="-1"/><TEXT>CLASSIFIED</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TRA data="0x00000000" mask="-1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT>The Omaha was one of the first Interdictor class battlecruisers produced. Launched from Norfolk Shipyard in 816, it carried on the legacy of the Liberty Dreadnaught of the same name lost in the Colony Wars. Omaha saw action in Texas during the Hudson War and supported Liberty's deep raids into Rheinland once the Hudson and Bering gates were blown. Being one of the first Interdictors made, it had many prototype systems aboard and suffered continual issues with the ship's temperamental power transfer systems. Once the Hudson War drew to a close, the danger of the Gallic advance into California demanded it press on despite its flaws. Omaha was transferred to California where it acted as an escort of the Battleship Yukon. Once the Battleship Carcassonne surrendered in 826, Omaha was withdrawn from front line service and sent to Juneau Shipyard to receive upgrades to bring it on-par with the rest of the Interdictor class. These upgrades were completed by 827, however Omaha's electrical issues were never fully resolved. The battlecruiser was found to be surplus to Navy requirements, and so Omaha was mothballed without ever having left Juneau.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 836, Kusari launched a surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard. Several of Omaha's newer sisters were damaged or destroyed in the attack, and the Liberty Navy found themselves without sufficient Interdictor coverage for the first time since the Gallic War. A new Interdictor crew was throw together from the Sailors of its sisters who were wounded, on liberty, or otherwise absent during the attack on Norfolk. Omaha was rapidly brought back online and, without any work beyond what was absolutely necessary, the circa 827 Interdictor was kicked out the door to free up shipyard space and provide for the defense of Liberty once more.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

With the Navy preferring to accept delays and focus on keeping their workforce trained, Midway's construction slowed to a crawl. Midway's construction only accelerated in 835 following the rise of tensions between Liberty and Kusari. Midway was launched to modest fanfare in mid 836.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Midway found itself in the Alaskan Corridor on shakedown cruise when Kusari launched their surprise attack on Norfolk Shipyard. Without ammunition or a fighter complement, Midway's crew could only listen in as comms traffic describing the attack came in. Even more than 1000 years after the Battle of Midway was fought in Sol, the ship's name is an irony and weight that is not lost upon the crew.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Saratoga's fierce actions ensured the gate was secured despite the loss of the Ottawa. Its shape is roughly that of a slightly arced dodecahedron, where each edge emitts a large, undulating tendril of light that sways rhythmically to the movements of the alien creature. It seems to have no purpose, simply appearing in places to observe, and quickly leaving if the situation becomes dangerous for it, disappearing in a cloud of blue particles just to appear elsewhere. However, those who have seen this species report to have been transfixed by its beauty, some even going so far as to unconsciously draw the creature's shape with their fingers or a pen. Whatever the purpose of this Nomad is, it is far more insidious than anything the Nomads have employed so far.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Mostly observed escorting groups of smaller craft, the Anzu is able to maneuver even through the most contested patches on a battlefield and avoid most of the fire directed its way. Its unique, lithe frame makes it nauseatingly difficult to hit even from up close, although the design philosophy with this species seems to have heavily favoured mobility over firepower or sustainability, as the Anzu is exceedingly vulnerable to enemy snubcraft as soon as its veil is depleted.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Still, the Anzu is a terrifying enemy to face, as it is extremely disruptive, all the while appearing as uncaring and persistent as any Nomad.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Thus the "Risosugyazara" was born in 180 AS, although it quickly gained the nickname "Scraper" among it's pilots. As it was still far from clear whether the colonies would thrive, Kusari, in a never repeated act of generosity, shared the design with all the four Houses, so that humanity itself would have a better chance at survival. The design was quickly adopted in all of Sirius.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Although over the years improvements have been made, the basic design is still the same. A small mining array and processor in the nose of the craft can pre-refine most minerals, and the robotic claws that provide its nickname can still be employed to latch the vessel to a medium sized asteroid, while either concussion torpedos or a large-scale blaster tears it to pieces. As with the Surveyor, miners have been known to employ their tools defensively, and over the years the upsurge in piracy has prompted mining companies to fit some defensive weapons to their Scrapers.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Crafting a functional and surprisingly well thought out vessel from old ship parts had long been a Junker tradition. The weapon contains a cryogenics package that condenses and supercools hydrogen around a fullerened antimatter payload into a supercooled "slug" of antimatter-doped hydrogen ice. The projectile is then sent down a barrel containing a number of graviton-generating toroids, which, at the cost of a significant amount of power, attract and repel it in sequence like a gauss gun, imparting a minimum of heat on the outer layers of hydrogen ice while accelerating it to an effective velocity.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The unquestionable superiority of the Mortar in capital warfare for long-range engagements compared to the relatively close-quarters plasma projectors used in Cerberus-type turrets, combined with the efficiency of a primarily energy-based weapon in a battle of attrition in contrast to conventional torpedoes, resulted in variants of the weapon being developed for cruisers and later battlecruisers, as well as a higher-input, higher-output version commonly known as the "Heavy Mortar". Regardless of the variant, the success of the Mortar ensured that the family of weapons would be seen on just about every warship in Sirius for centuries to come.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Heavy Mortar

While some fleet doctrines prefer the standard Mortar for its relative rapidity, others choose the Heavy Mortar on the grounds that if you can rip an enemy ship apart in a single volley, you don't need to worry about when you can fire the next.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

It was commissioned by Britain's King Edward I for his siege of Stirling Castle in Scotland during a rebellion. The Gallic Royal Navy chose the name for this ironic quality, since it was first deployed in their assault on Bretonia. The gun creates the most devastating non-nuclear blast in existence, delivering more than twice as much destructive power as a Mortar. The weapon is capable of obliterating conventional cruisers in one shot to their hulls, and causes massive concussion waves throughout battleships and dreadnoughts, incapacitating crew members that somehow survive the impact. The weapon's energy requirements and long recharge time are significant, and are its only disadvantage. The Gallic Navy considers use of the weapon so important that relatively high ranking officers act as its gunner under direct command of an admiral, and these officers have been known to be court martialed or demoted for failing to hit their target, since use of the weapon prevents the ship from firing other weapons due to the energy drain. Gallic Navy combat doctrine calls for the "Warwolf" to be deployed primarily as an opening salvo in engagements versus capital ships, since its use significantly impedes use of the ship's other weapons systems. Loss of shields while in range of an Gallic Navy battleship that has sufficient energy to fire this weapon is almost suicidal for a capital ship.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Caution is advised.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Bretonia has been forced to retreat from the GRN onslaught, and Leeds is now under the total control of Gallia. The GRN's seemingly unstoppable advance has overflowed into other systems, and even now their scouts encroach upon the Independent Worlds that connect Bretonia to Liberty. However, in response to Gallia's increasing threat, Liberty is diverting some of its own naval squadrons to the region in order to slow the hostile advance and protect the key shipping lines between the two Houses. This is only becoming possible due to drastic action by Rheinland, in which they severed the Jump Gates to the Hamburg system in order to halt further Libertonian attacks. While these two Houses are still technically at war, the scale of the conflict has been greatly reduced.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>However, despite facing less aggression from Liberty, the choice to focus its attention on that war front in previous years has had dire consequences behind the lines. Soon the Kusari Exile fleet will be returning home, and it will not be quiet.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Discovery version 4.87 is focussed on improving and updating much of the content added in previous version, with greater diversity of equipment available for different ship classes.
