Please read complete and up-to-date server rules at www.discoverygc.com. If you are not playing on the Discovery 24/7 RP server, you must refer to your server's rules instead of the rules listed below.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Discovery RP 24/7 is a role-playing server. This means you are expected to behave and communicate like the pilot of your ship, and refrain from using any emoticons, leet terms and Out of Roleplay (OoRP) form of speech in system or local chat.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Communication between players is essential for gameplay, and you are not recommended to play without decent knowledge of English. Threats and insults are only allowed on the server if used within roleplay.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Names of characters must be pronounceable, free of special symbols (except faction tags), emoticons and leet terms. Do not overuse numbers and capital letters.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Since Discovery is a role-playing server, all PvP engagements should be reasonable in terms of RP. The ID of the victim must be scanned prior to attack. ID status has a priority over red/white/green color on HUD.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Attacking characters of level 29 and below which use Recruit ID is prohibited. For exceptions to this, refer to the complete version of the server rules.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A player who was killed in a PvP fight is not allowed to re-engage using any of his/her characters within 2 hours. Characters of a player who was killed in a PvP fight must not return into the system where the fight took place within 2 hours. Fleeing from combat by docking on a station or planet while still within the scanner range of hostile vessels counts as PvP death.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Aggressors are not allowed to destroy a trade vessel prior to issuing a demand in system or local chat, and allowing sufficient time to respond. "Halt" is not a demand, however, a trade vessel may be destroy if they refuse to stop after being asked to in form of a proper demand.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>For purposes of the server rules:</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>- All light fighters, heavy fighters, very heavy fighters, super heavy fighters, and bombers are considered fighters</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Cargo ships with cargo hold less than 750 units are considered freighters</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>- Cargo ships with cargo hold more than 750 units, including liners, are considered transports</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>- Gunboats, cruisers (including destroyers and battlecruisers), battleships (including carriers) are considered capital ships.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Cheating, hacking attempts, and abusive or insulting behavior toward other players is not tolerated.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TRA data="1" mask="1" def="-2"/><JUST loc="center"/><TEXT>Properties</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0" mask="1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT>Base Price: $1</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Container Hitpoints: 4000</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Cargo Space Per Unit: 1</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Developed by The Order and their allies, most notably the Bundschuh and Blood Dragons, it was originally a prototype design of the Liberty Security Force known as "Project Discovery". Characterized by combining the strengths of scanners available on the market in exchange for sacrificing a portion of the vessel's hold, after nearly three decades of research and struggle the Order and their allies saw the project through and thus revealed the new Wiretap scanner.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT> Range: 18000</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> Cargo Scan Range: 9500</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Traditional shielding draws from the ship's main power plant to generate and maintain the 'bubble' of charged particles; the FRENZY, however, houses a dedicated power source of its own.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The device is composed of a custom-built and notably smaller shield generator coupled directly to a micro-reactor of experimental design, with the whole construction encased in a standard-sized housing that permits it to be installed in medium-sized snubcraft. The tradeoff, however, is obvious; the compact size of the shield generator itself limits its strength, and the FRENZY falters in defensive capability compared to its more conventional counterparts.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Molecular shields take 20% less damage from explosives, such as mines and missiles.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="1" mask="1" def="-2"/><JUST loc="center"/><TEXT>Blackmarket CNOCx Series Engine Clone</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0" mask="1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><PARA/><TEXT>Due to the aesthetically pleasing nature of Gallic engines, the high demand from the youth of Sirius and even other adventurous pilots have led independent ship manufacturers to attempt converting said engines to function with Sirian ship designs and common fuels. 917504
Arrival of Freeport 7 Survivors
917505
Just moments ago, the survivors of the Freeport 7 disaster arrived here in Manhattan. After two days of intense travel, several of the survivors required immediate medical attention. Requests by the LSF to conduct interviews concerning the attack have been declined by the medical commissioner. Meanwhile, the official death toll has risen to 2,600, making it the most devastating disaster in recent history.
917506
Rheinland Admiral in Manhattan
917507
Rheinland Admiral Otto Schultzky arrives in Manhattan today to meet with President Jacobi. Though they plan to discuss a new trade proposal,  the President says that a heightened cooperative security measure will be on their agenda as well in light of the recent Freeport 7 tragedy. The admiral's flagship, the RNC Donau, will arrive in Manhattan today under heavy guard.
917508
Jacobi Hopeful about Meeting
917509
The President was candid today when asked about her upcoming meeting with Admiral Schultzky. She said that despite recently strained diplomatic ties, this is a positive gesture from Chancellor Niemann. Jacobi and Schultzky have met on several occasions before his formal diplomatic appointment, and she has previously described him as "a man of reason, committed to peace."
917510
Freeport 7 Public Reaction
917511
Citizens everywhere are still in shock at the news of Freeport 7's destruction. The station, operated by the Zoners, served as a neutral trading facility for all walks of life from around the galaxy. In the face of the catastrophic loss of life and the growing consensus that this was most likely a deliberate attack, people are struggling to grasp the motive behind this senseless act of violence.
917512
Market Holds Trades
917513
In Manhattan, the center of galactic trade, all orders were held for one minute in honor of those lost on Freeport 7. The market remains more sluggish than usual at this time. However, analysts expect a full recovery.
917514
Liberty Mediates BW Talks
917515
Negotiations slowed to a crawl yesterday as delegates from Kusari and Rheinland heatedly debated acquisitions in the Border Worlds. Kusari had proposed a "full disclosure" initiative, which was protested and then effectively blocked by Rheinland. Recent territorial disputes in the Border Worlds, largely driven by the discovery of a wealth of new resources and Artifacts, have sparked these talks between the colonies, with Liberty acting as mediator. However, with the delegates now polarized over this issue, it is unclear how effective these talks will be.
917516
Military to Investigate FP7
917517
Government sources say that because of The Order's potential involvement, President Jacobi has put the investigation of Freeport 7 into the hands of a special unit within the Liberty Military. This corps of investigators will be charged with securing the wreckage, gathering evidence, and coordinating with forensic teams in the solemn task of recovering and identifying human remains.
917518
Doctors Hold Off LSF Inquiry
917519
A group of Freeport 7 survivors, many of whom were critically injured, were taken to the Williams-Creek Medical Center for treatment. There they were triaged, and some underwent emergency, life-saving procedures. Agents of the LSF were also on hand to question those who could talk, but doctors insisted that they be allowed to recover before being subjected to the added stress. The LSF acquiesced but insisted that these patients be kept in a secure location within the medical center. Doctors have set aside Ward 13 for their convalescence.
917520
Schultzky Killed in Manhattan
917521
Rheinland Admiral Otto Schultzky has been assassinated by members of The Order! The President was visibly shaken when she heard that the ship carrying the Admiral was totally destroyed on its final approach to Newark Station. After extending her condolences to Rheinland, she ordered a full inquest, immediately charging the LSF to pursue The Order as its number one priority.
917522
Reaction to FP7 Investigation
917523
Other voices in Sirius have begun to question Liberty's move to place military forces in what has always been an apolitical, neutral zone. Some have said that this investigation should be an open, pan-colonial undertaking and that the stationing of military forces in Sigma-17 violates charter settlement agreements between the Houses and other factions. To assuage these concerns, President Jacobi spoke, insisting that the recent movement of The Order required immediate action. She also stated that our forces were there to prevent further contamination of the area and to execute a thorough investigation -- nothing more. Jacobi went on to stress that our formal presence at the Freeport 7 site would be exclusive and temporary, and that the sum of the findings would be shared with all affected government agencies.
917524
New York Crime Wave on the Rise?
917525
Are we at greater risk at home now more than ever? That's the question. When The Order penetrated our defenses to kill Otto Schultzky nearly on the very steps of the presidential palace, many of our illusions about our own security were affected. Add to this the destruction of Freeport 7 and the sharp increase of attacks by the Liberty Rogues in New York, and we begin to feel anxiety and uneasiness about our personal and economic security. The President and the LSF say that they are addressing these concerns, but without concrete results we are still left asking the questions, "Are these events related? And what can we do about The Order?"
917526
Niemann Blames Liberty for Death
917527
Chancellor Niemann of Rheinland spoke out bitterly today, citing lax security and blaming Liberty for the recent death of Admiral Schultzky during his visit. Niemann went on to say that he would personally punish those responsible, regardless of where they hide.
917528
FP7 Survivors to Talk
917529
Manhattan -- Doctors at the WCMC have given the go ahead for Special LSF investigators to interview many of the Freeport 7 survivors. Despite an earlier recommendation against this course of action, we are told that government pressures have motivated physicians to allow at least a conditional line of questioning of select patients. It is hoped that their eyewitness testimony will help to shed some light on who truly is responsible.
917530
Local Crime Ring Smashed
917531
Seemingly in answer to growing security concerns, LSF forces took action and delivered a crushing blow to Liberty Rogues operating secretly near Pittsburgh. Following up on details from an ongoing investigation, the well-hidden base was rooted out and surgically eliminated by agents who acted under tactical LSF authority. Aemon Bonnerille of the LSF promises that this is just the beginning, as he intends to "tighten the noose around the neck of organized crime."
917532
Local Prison Ship Rescued
917533
Just before LSF fighters closed in on a secret Rogue base near Pittsburgh, they were instrumental in fighting off a coordinated attack on a local prison ship. Prison Ship XT-19 is generally used as a staging area for prisoners being shuttled between processing stations and more permanent lockdowns in Texas. It was during such a transfer that the Rogues suddenly attacked and overran its defenses. Authorities believe that the Rogues were attempting to liberate a group of its own members being interrogated onboard. Fortunately, however, the LSF arrived just in time to repel the pirates and avert disaster. Though XT-19 sustained heavy damage, we are told that the ship was successfully towed to Baltimore Shipyard for repairs.
917534
Liberty Imposes Artifact Ban
917535
President Jacobi announced today that, based on the appearance of new, unstudied, and potentially dangerous classes of Artifacts in Liberty, she is temporarily suspending all Artifact trading, pending further investigation. Despite initial protests, she has assured trade union reps that they will be adequately compensated and that, once evaluated, regulated trading will resume. Authorities have asked all citizens to comply with this temporary precaution until more can be learned.
917536
Big Guns Stand Vigil at our Gates
917537
Responding to the public outcry on security issues, the government has now placed battleships at all Jump Gates on Liberty's borders. Though some citizens are comforted by Liberty's actions for better protection from both foreign attack and domestic smuggling and crime, others are concerned over the freedoms we might be sacrificing as we resort to potentially harsher military involvement to maintain security.
917538
Trouble in Zone 21?
917539
Civilian listening posts reported an unusual disturbance coming from Zone 21. Despite its exaggerated reputation among conspiracy buffs as an area for so-called "secret research," navy officials say that Zone 21 is only used for legitimate weapons testing and strategic training. They had no comment at this time about the disturbance.
917540
Evidence pointing to The Order
917541
The LSF today has said that between the material retrieved from the Freeport 7 site and the weight of survivor testimony, there is sufficient evidence to support allegations that The Order did in fact participate in the Freeport 7 attack. Though officials have yet to ascribe a motive to The Order's actions, or the exact weapons used, this new evidence has caused them to narrow their focus to establish an "operative presence" onboard the station prior to its destruction. They are now 100 percent confident that at least one Order member was on Freeport 7 hours before it was destroyed.
917542
Some FP7 Survivors Dead, Missing
917543
Doctors at the Williams-Creek Medical Center have reported several deaths in Ward 13, the sealed treatment facility for the survivors of Freeport 7. "These deaths are regrettable," they say, but not surprising due to their extensive injuries. However, we've also learned that at least one patient appears to be unaccounted for at this time. Though doctors and LSF officials refused to comment, we understand that hospital security is looking into the matter.
917544
FP7 Manifest Sought
917545
As investigators search the Freeport 7 wreckage for clues, the one missing piece of the puzzle appears to be the station's manifest. Once the manifest has been found and analyzed, authorities believe they will be able to accurately depict the final hours of the station right down to who was present on it, what ships were docked, and perhaps even how it might have been destroyed.
917546
Explosion in Zone 21 Was Attack
917547
After avoiding questions earlier, the Liberty Military has confirmed the sabotage of a Liberty cruiser in Zone 21. They also said that a coded transmission coming from within the cruiser just prior to its destruction was intercepted and deciphered. Based on the contents of the message, military authorities suspect operatives working for The Order. However, they do not know yet how saboteurs could have penetrated security to board the ship. The antimatter bomb that was detonated inside created a blast zone large enough to consume three cruisers and damage several nearby ships. There were no survivors in the suicide bombing, and the names of the ships and crewmen are being withheld at this time.
917548
Orillion Named as Order leader
917549
Today the President announced two contributions that advanced the exposure of The Order's leadership infrastructure: evidence provided by the LSF, and the decoded transmission from Zone 21. Jacobi says that there are repeated references to a single individual known only as "Orillion." LSF analysts believe this to be a codename.  The President says that now it is only a matter of time before The Order will be rooted out and brought to justice.
917550
Pueblo Station Nearly Destroyed
917551
Reports have come in that Pueblo Station was viciously attacked by a well-organized band of smugglers under the direction of the notorious Sean Ashcroft. Even though rescue vehicles, medics, and LSF reinforcements arrived at the scene, damage to the station was nearly total, and Pueblo suffered many casualties. Ashcroft, a known Artifact smuggler, was subsequently apprehended by LSF agents and is being held in an unnamed LSF facility for questioning.
917552
LSF Tightens Criminal Noose
917553
LSF Director Aemon Bonnerille announced that his organization is continuing to tighten its grasp on piracy, smuggling, and all other illegal activities. Though some minor detractors claim that the methods being used are a violation of rights, others are relieved that the government is finally taking a more active role in domestic security.
917554
Kusari - Rheinland Anxiety Grows
917555
Despite repeated attempts by the President to smooth relations, Chancellor Niemann of Rheinland continues to insist that Kusari is guilty of theft, espionage, and now even conspiracy with The Order. Kusari has flatly denied these allegations, calling the Chancellor's actions "slanderous," and accusing Rheinland of taking armed action against Kusari ships in the Border Worlds.
917556
Rheinland Station Attacked
917557
More trouble in Rheinland -- this time in the Hamburg system. Sources there report that a scientific research station was looted by marauders and left severely damaged. Investigators deny speculation that The Order might be involved, saying that evidence points instead to a small group of pirates allegedly backed by Kusari interests.
917558
Is Orillion Operating in Liberty?
917559
Sources say that there may be a relationship between organized crime and the movements of The Order. Moreover, there is a remote possibility that its leader, Orillion, may be operating within the confines of Liberty under criminal "protection." Though the LSF has officially downplayed this idea, they say that they are following up on every legitimate lead to expose Orillion, The Order, and whatever ties they may have.
917560
Rogue Attack on Ft. Bush
917561
Reports of an unprovoked Rogue attack on Ft. Bush surfaced today. Witnesses say that the Liberty Rogues suddenly appeared and began to attack several ships and the large station. This kind of attack is historically very unusual for them, say analysts, but consistent with recent Rogue behavior. Though the pirates were repelled and there was only minor damage reported by the station, this does raise some concern for the ongoing security issues in Liberty right now.
917562
Radicals Commit Suicide
917563
The Liberty Military reports that several subversives and radical sympathizers of The Order have recently committed suicide rather than face arrest. Although the names of these suspects are being withheld at this time, authorities say that they are still part of an ongoing investigation.
917564
LSF Conducts Internal Meetings
917565
With Liberty's security in the balance, Aemon Bonnerille said that the LSF was developing a new internal plan for dealing with security issues. Though he declined to share the details of his new initiative, he has scheduled meetings with all key LSF control personnel.
917566
Kusari, Rheinland Square off
917567
Shogun Edo of Kusari is said to have taken great umbrage towards recent remarks made by Chancellor Niemann. Edo bitterly dismissed the accusations of conspiracy and espionage, accusing the Chancellor of clouding the issues of his illegal operations in the Border Worlds and his infringement of the Boorman Treaty, which forbids armed aggression between the major Houses.
917568
Orillion Death Yields Few Answers
917569
Aemon Bonnerille, Director of the LSF, said, "I hope that with the death of Orillion, information about The Order's operations in Liberty and elsewhere will be quickly discovered." However, with more questions than answers right now, some people feel that the only man who could have shed light on Freeport 7 and other criminal acts was silenced by the LSF.
917570
Rheinland Foreign Minister Dead
917571
Karl Ettinger, Foreign Minister of Rheinland, was reportedly killed in a bomb blast earlier today. Ettinger was en route to inspect the remains of the Hamburg Station when a fusion bomb, apparently hidden in one of his attending ships, detonated, killing everyone. Rheinland authorities say they are investigating the site of the incident, but since the destruction was so utterly complete, they have little to go on at this time.
917572
Rheinland ships in Liberty?
917573
Rheinland Military ships allegedly entered Liberty space today and opened fire without warning. The President immediately contacted Chancellor Niemann, who denied that there were any official military units in the area. Military officials had no immediate comment but said that the incident is under investigation.
917574
Rheinland Allegations
917575
Chancellor Niemann is said to have spoken directly with both President Jacobi and Queen Carina of Bretonia about the allegations he has raised against Kusari. Niemann has accused Kusari of backing The Order in its attacks against Rheinland and Liberty, and has now added the assassination of Karl Ettinger to his list of charges.
917576
Freeport 7 Manifest Found!
917577
The Freeport 7 data manifest has been found, according to the LSF. Agents finally discovered the sought-after module in a palette of wreckage reportedly salvaged by the Junkers. The data manifest, we are told, was acquired and immediately taken to the LSF labs for analysis. Based on the extracted data, investigators are certain that Orillion was indeed on Freeport 7 just prior to its destruction.
917578
Rheinland Fortifies KU Border
917579
There is what can only be described as a Rheinland Military buildup on their side of the shared border with Kusari. Kusari, denying any wrongdoing, has deployed ships as well and adopted a defensive stance of its own in response to this action.
917580
Liberty, Bretonia Propose Summit
917581
Recent action on the Rheinland/Kusari border has caused other colonies great concern. In answer to this, President Jacobi and Lord Quigley of Bretonia have jointly proposed an emergency summit meeting to bring about a peaceful settlement. Lord Quigley, who has had a long career in successful diplomatic negotiations, is said to be acting under the direct wishes of his cousin, Queen Carina. There is no word yet on the Chancellor's response to this proposal.
917582
Manifest Exposes Orillion
917583
Based on its most current evidence and testimony, the LSF believes that Orillion, a.k.a. Sam Lonnigan, came to Freeport 7 to steal several large shipments of unusually expensive goods and Artifacts that were in its bays. Once his agents took control of the shipments and presumably eliminated its rightful owners, it is believed that he ordered the ships to take off and to destroy the station to cover their tracks. Lonnigan was likely to have been the last to leave. However, for whatever reason, he was caught in his own trap and was injured in the blast. Lonnigan was brought to Liberty by rescue ship and was admitted to the WCMC. Local Order operatives liberated him from Ward 13, and after his quick recovery, they implemented a wave of terror using Manhattan as a new base of operations. The LSF now says that it has all it needs to identify Lonnigan's accomplices, who may still be at large.
917584
Boorman Treaty Violated?
917585
Shogun Edo now insists that Rheinland's continued military actions show them to be in complete violation of the Boorman Treaty. Edo's tone was almost accusatory in itself, as he asked why Liberty refused to help the Kusari people. The President, in fact, did speak to both powers today, asking them to reduce the buildup at their borders and to present their respective issues at the proposed summit meeting.
917586
Curacao Summit is Now Set
917587
With Rheinland finally agreeing to attend, the summit meeting is now moving forward. Delegates, including our own Secretary Ballenshine representing Liberty, are to attend the meeting on Curacao sometime in the coming week.
917588
Ballenshine Pronounced Dead
917589
Liberty Secretary James Ballenshine collapsed today and was evacuated to a government medical unit, where he was pronounced dead of natural causes. President Jacobi said that his sudden passing will not diminish Liberty's commitment to peace and stability in the colonies. She will now be attending the summit meeting on Curacao in his place.
917590
Rheinland Blockade in Omega
917591
In an unprovoked move, Rheinland has imposed blockades on Jump Gates in Omega-7. Officials have called this "an outrageous breach of trust and protocol that we cannot stand for." Queen Carina and her cabinet have called for the Chancellor to immediately withdraw his forces, now impinging on Bretonian interests in that area. "Though we have been tolerant thus far," the Queen said, "this hostile act casts a dark shadow on our relationship and will be met with equal force if need be."
917592
Lord Quigley Gunned Down
917593
We are stunned by the news that Lord Arnold Benson Quigley, Foreign Minister to the Crown of Bretonia, has been found brutally murdered in his home. The Queen was informed and has firmly charged investigators to find those responsible. This is a duty, we are assured, they have solemnly accepted. Thus far there are no official suspects. However, an off-the-record source did say that they are not ruling out the work of The Order, who may be trying to derail the frail peace process in Sirius.
917594
Shots Fired on Bretonian Soil
917595
Conflict broke out in Omega today as Rheinland ships, becoming ever bolder, opened fire on a nearby Bretonian patrol in the area. The Chancellor has said that the Rheinland blockade is only looking after Rheinland's interests in the area and claimed that they were provoked by Bretonian fighters. As tempers flair and peace hangs in the balance, Queen Carina contemplates her next move with her advisors.
917596
Are There Changes in Rheinland?
917597
News from the Foreign Office indicates that things may be heating up in Rheinland. Reports from the inside say that Rheinland citizens are being stirred up against Kusari by what are being described as "agitator groups."  Meanwhile, the Chancellor has just announced that the military is now activating its reserve fighters to bolster homeland defense. Royal analysts have reported this information to the Queen and have advised her that Rheinland may be preparing for war.
917598
Who Killed Lord Quigley?
917599
As national mourning continues for Lord Quigley, so does the manhunt for those responsible for his murder. Authorities, still tight-lipped about their investigation, have recently ruled out the involvement of many domestic suspects. This only further fuels local speculation that The Order may be directly responsible for Quigley's death. However, we are told that this might not necessarily be the case. Based on new evidence, investigators are examining a host of foreign leads in an effort to find Quigley's killers before they can act again.
917600
Queen to Attend Summit
917601
Despite Rheinland's recent aggressive stance and the assassination of Lord Quigley, the Curacao summit meeting is still set to proceed. In a surprise move, Queen Carina will now join President Jacobi and other representatives at the table, taking her cousin's place.
917602
Disappearances Trouble HO
917603
Today in the Home Office, a report stated that missing persons cases are at their highest in years. Compared to other population centers in the galaxy, Bretonia has often been considered one of the more peaceful, and so these numbers are thought to be erroneous. The Home Office has asked for a recount and more information before it officially publishes its statistics.
917604
Ballenshine Was Murdered
917605
Despite Liberty's official statement that James Ballenshine died of "natural causes," several entries in his sealed autopsy report detail certain anomalies. In information leaked to our press, it was noted that for a man who reportedly died of a heart attack, Mr. Ballenshine was in fact missing his heart altogether, as well as his eyes and his brain. These gruesome details were apparently omitted from Liberty's records. However, they now indicate that Mr. Ballenshine was just another unfortunate victim in a wave of recent high-profile murders.
917606
Contact Lost with Remote Team
917607
Communication was lost today with a Cambridge University-sponsored archeological dig in the Border Worlds. University officials showed some concern, but in the absence of an emergency broadcast, they believe that the older communication equipment at the site must have failed. A repair crew will be dispatched to repair the problem.
917608
Shooting at Curacao, Queen Safe
917609

Matsumoto itself sustained moderate damage in the engagement, relatively untouched by Chrysanthemum bombers however still suffering the ill effects of Matsuda's anti-capital weaponry. [833 AS] Kyushu Faces Rising Temperatures And Falling Profits
919205
Kyushu, the key to Samura's monopoly on the organically-grown food industry, has faced rising ocean temperatures lately, owing to a vast temperature surge in the mantle plume underneath its largest ocean. This has been compounded by the resultant eruption of several underwater volcanoes, releasing enormous quantities of greenhouse gases into the planet's atmosphere.  Partially as a result of the geological activity, the equatorial monsoon season produced some of the strongest tropical storms ever recorded on Kyushu since its colonisation. These storms devastated the world's agricultural sector as they blew through the most fertile tropical lowlands, destroying as much as 20％ of the planet's annual crop yield, on top of damage to infrastructure and tragic loss of human life.  Many rural communities are reported to be struggling, with some farming communities still remaining flooded ghost towns even a month after the worst of the storms abated, though smaller-scale tempests still rage around the equator. A Samura spokesperson outlined the company's intent to restore the planet and its communities to full productivity by the middle of next year, despite the ongoing circumstance.

1114199
[819 AS] Rheinland Forces Destroy Jump Gates To Hamburg!
1114200
MANHATTAN -- 819 AS -- In what military analysts call an act of desperation, Rheinland has sabotaged and destroyed both the Bering and Hudson Jump Gates leading into Hamburg. The damage is still being assessed, but initial scans by Deep Space Engineering maintenance teams suggest the gates are both a total loss. Carriers Roanoke and Weatherlight were both lost to the Rheinland Jump Gate sabotage, with over half their crew lost in the subsequent implosion. This unprecedented move has effectively ceded both Bering and Hudson to Liberty. While Liberty Naval patrols will keep a close eye on any Rheinland activity, it seems likely the bulk of the Rheinland fleet will now concentrate its actions in New Hampshire, where Battleship Concord was forced to withdraw. With Hudson no longer in dispute, Liberty has dispatched Battleship Alma to secure the Atka terraforming operation, and has asked Planetform to resume the terraforming process.
1114201
[818 AS] Daumann Engineers Develop New Ship
1114202
THE RING -- 818 AS -- Despite the relentless Libertonian push on our fatherland, the last few months of war were not in vain! Daumann engineers have today unveiled the product of many months of development, designed to support our operations on the very front: the Elbe class carrier. Financed in part by the wealthy Rutger family from New Berlin, the design was completed just a few months ago after a complete battlefield analysis of Liberty Navy force composition. This ship was thus designed from the ground up to supplement Rheinland forces against the Libertonian invader. Its armament and size will make it especially effective in supporting the fighter craft based from its landing bays. The ship is expected to make its first appearance on the front lines in a few weeks time.
1114203
[818 AS] Naval Forces Deploy New Battlecruiser
1114204
YOKOHAMA -- 818 AS -- The Komainu class battlecruiser is a rare example of the engineering prowess of Kusari's two great keiretsu joined in one hull and the latest addition to the Kusari Naval Forces shipline. The project has lead many critics to wonder what might have been achieved if Samura and Kishiro had set aside their commercial ambitions much earlier in service to the State.  In the clear expanse of Kusari hub systems, the advantage was with the largest and most heavily armored of capital ships. However, the Komainu was designed for a significantly different theatre of war. While the Kusari Battleships blazed a path through the Tau systems and into Bretonia, they struggled to maintain an efficient hold on that territory due to the hostile maneuvering environment of the asteroid fields. In their stead, the Komainu guards the gates of Kusari in the Tau systems, and combines a sleek hull with the firepower to destroy any threat to its sacred home.
1114205
[818 AS] Kusari Declares War Against Gallia!
1114206
NEW TOKYO -- 818 AS -- In a shock announcement, the Shogun of the Kusari Government has declared war against the Kingdom of Gallia. Efforts to negotiate a settlement regarding a joint invasion of Bretonia have broken down, and fighting between elements of the GRN and KNF are already coming in from across the Tau sector. Casualties are expected to be high, with initial reports suggesting many thousands could perish within the first few weeks of conflict.
1114207
[818 AS] Gallia Claims Tau-31, Kusari Forces Mobilise
1114208
NEW TOKYO -- 818 AS -- The Kingdom of Gallia, a relative newcomer in Sirius politics, was today reported to have sent an invasion fleet into independent Tau-23 and Tau-31 and has requested all military forces present there to withdraw immediately. The Gallia Royal Navy, the main naval force behind their house, is estimated to hold numbers far exceeding those of even the greatly overdeveloped Liberty Navy, to this date considered the largest navy in the colonies. Although it is currently unclear whether Gallia forces have any intent to fire on Kusari forces enforcing the imperial claim to Tau-31, The Kusari Government has called for an immediate meeting between commanders from both sides, referring to the Gallic claims as "deeply offensive to the Kusari nation".  The Honourable Emperor Jien Kogen is currently personally leading Kusari Naval Forces in Leeds despite mounting pressure for his return home. His response to the situation is as of yet unknown.
1114209
[818 AS] Tau Border Worlds Taken By Gallia
1114210
JAVA -- 818 AS -- In as many years as the Independent Miners Guild has existed, the Tau systems have never witnessed a troop movement on this scale as the one we are witnessing right now. Gallia, a new arrival on the Sirius political scene, did not waste time in making war on two of the biggest warmongers. The force they sent in to seize the systems separating the two however outnumbers both the Bretonian and Kusari navies combined. This means that Tau-23 and Tau-31 is now officially under Gallia rule, with all IMG personnel subject to their war time laws. IMG Guild Masters are wasting no time in assuring the public that they will do everything in their power to ensure that this transition goes through as smoothly as possible.  Niobium prices are expected to rise as a result of the added danger of operating here, so hopefully not a great lot of you will leave the confines of Java station for safer pastures.
1114211
[818 AS] Naval Forces Stuck In Bretonia?
1114212
HOLMAN -- 818 AS -- The last five years have been anything but boring for the inhabitants of Holman: the Bretonian-Kusari war, Bretonian occupation soon turning into Kusari occupation, many "accidental" shots hitting Holman itself through all the fighting occuring right next to it, and now Tau-31 seized by storm by the biggest naval taskforce seen to date in the history of the colonies. It would seem that the only option left for Holman is either to evacuate themselves to safety or to bow down to their new Gallian overlords. But can Gallia really hold Tau-31? Even though Kusari officially backed out of the war, a large chunk of their navy disagrees with this decision. Supposedly led by their former Emperor Jien Kogen, they have banded together with what remains of the Bretonian Armed Forces in Newcastle, bent on kicking the Gallia Naval Forces out of Tau-31. Only time will tell if they will succeed however.
1114213
[818 AS] Armistice Signed With Kusari Forces
1114214
NEW LONDON -- 818 AS -- In the face of the impending Gallia invasion fleet and rising threat of an attack on Leeds, the Kusari Emperor-in-Exile has seen fit to step forward and present the Queen's government with an offer of peace and alliance against the Royal Navy. The Queen has officially signed the agreement only yesterday, but the general order to cease all hostility against former KNF forces in Bretonia has already been issued. The secretary of state has also used the occassion to announce a call to arms, stressing the inevitability of the Gallian invasion of Bretonia. The remaining Kusari forces in Bretonia are expected to make their base somewhere in Newcastle, and will help with the defense of the system against any Gallian attacks.
1114215
[818 AS] ATTN Naval Forces: Our Current Situation
1114216
BATTLESHIP YAMAGUCHI -- 818 AS -- In light of the recent events on the Bretonian front, the honourable Emperor Kogen addresses all Naval Forces still under Imperial command:  "To Our Honourable Samurai still serving in the war against the foreign devils, After years of victories against the Bretonians, nobody could have ever expected such a course of events to come to bear. The past from Sol is coming back to haunt us in the form of this French house, declaring war upon us from a position of surprise and dishonour. Their limitless hordes are too many to stand against on our lonesome, even for such proven warriors as the valiant Seto battlegroup. We will receive no more support from our homeland, as they have decided to abandon my wisdom in favour of what they perceive to be their own.  We cannot, will not dishonour those who died for Kusari's right to the Tau sector by retreating like cowards! The Kusari Naval Forces are proud, we cannot be defeated! Making war on the Bretonians was honourable, we fought each other from a position of tactics and the superiority of ideals. This Gallia has no regard for either ideals, nor tactics, nor honour!  My fellow samurai, the Bretonians may be our enemy but our feud was interrupted and defiled, and for this affront we must strike back. We will reclaim Tau-31 from the dishonourable Gallians so that we can finish what has been started."
1114217
[818 AS] New Draft Measure Passes
1114218
NEW LONDON -- 818 AS -- The New London Parliament has spent the last few days discussing almost exclusively matters of war as the threat of an invasion of Leeds, much bigger than what was ever expected from Kusari forces, now forms like a shadow cast by the incredible numbers of ships that Gallia has sent to fuel their imperialist conquest of the Tau systems. Several measures were passed by almost unanimous vote, including forming an emergency leading party coalition for the duration of the war with Gallia, war time resource rationing and, perhaps most controversially, a general draft. All able bodied citizens from ages 18 to 40 will soon be receiving their draft letters and will be commissioned as either full time troops or reserves. All Bretonian shipbuilding companies are expected to receive large scale rapid ship construction contracts shortly as a direct result of this.
1114219
[818 AS] Council Forces Evacuated From Languedoc
1114220
TOULOUSE -- 818 AS -- As the last Council evacuation ship makes it out of Languedoc toward the newly colonized system of Roussillon, Council forces breathe a sigh of relief knowing they have managed to get away from the blunt hammer of the Royal Navy forces. While it was obvious from the start that Languedoc would not be held for very long, it seems the Council has far underestimated the veracity of the Royal Navy as the first assault waves advanced into the system long before the end of the evacuation effort. The evacuation was nonetheless completed successfully thanks to the valiant efforts of a last ditch defense fleet who have managed to hold the Royal Navy at bay at great cost. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten, nor will it be in vain. The Council will begin efforts to sabotage Royal Navy operations in the Tau sector within the space of a few weeks.
1114221
[819 AS] Liberty Attacks Research Outpost In Bremen!
1114222
HAMBURG -- 819 AS -- Rheinland defense forces in Bremen sent out a general distress call today following an unexpected suicide attack by the Liberty Navy which successfully disabled the Battleship Westphalia and allowed a good portion of their strike force waiting on the other side to jump through unharmed. The Liberty forces used a similar tactic to the one use by the Kusari Naval Forces in their breakthrough to Leeds over two years ago. While the heroic crew of the Westphalia restored their stricken vessel, the Liberty fleet attacked and plundered a civilian research outpost elsewhere in the system. Reinforcements from New Berlin quickly drove back the attackers, destroying a good number of them. The Westphalia is reported to be pursuing the remaining attackers in New Hampshire.
1114223
[819 AS] Casablanca Falls!
1114224
VIERNHEIM -- 819 AS -- After years of Hessian occupation, the Corsairs have finally launched an attack strong enough to overwhelm the defense at Casablanca and have retaken the base. It has taken them more than eight years to accomplish this, and it was something that allowed the Red Hessian movement to continuously raid their supply transports to and from Gran Canaria, dealing the Corsairs greater blows than on any other front. While this will undoubtedly create new battle lines in Omega-47 and Omega-5 now that the Corsairs have secured their supply line, the Red Hessian Oberkommando has stated that counter assaults are already in preparation and that the war over Omega-47 is only set to escalate. Meanwhile, Omega-47 operational command has been moved to Viernheim base, which has been fortified against possible Corsair raiding parties. Preparations for the first counterstrike continue.
1114225
[819 AS] The Council Begins Munitions Sales to Sirian Factions
1114226
TOULOUSE -- 819 AS -- Capitalizing on the proficiency of its work force in the munitions industry, The Council's first industrial product manufactured in its new home is Munitions. The Munitions are being stockpiled to replenish the fleet from its recent operations against the Royal Fleet, but are also being sold throughout Sirius to factions who are desperate for a reliable, low cost source of Munitions on the black market. The Council sees these economic ties as the beginning of possible new alliances for the faction, as well as a way to create sympathy and attract support for their own fight against the Crown.
1114227
[819 AS] Outcast Shipwrights Unveil New Ship Designs
1114228

[819 AS] Alien Bacteria Re-engineered for Air Filtration And Waste Disposal
1114254
COLD BAY DEPOT -- 819 AS -- In 815 AS, a Planetform survey vessel discovered an unknown bacteria indigenous to Planet Atka in the Hudson system. Further study conducted after the construction of Cold Bay Depot in 816 AS revealed that the bacterial organisms had evolved the unique ability to split carbon atoms from their adjoining elements in order to use the carbon as a food source. Any molecular structure containing carbon can be "digested" by these bacteria. The digestion process consumes approximately half of the carbon in the molecule as fuel for the bacteria, and secretes the remainder along with other elements back into the environment. Planetform scientists speculate that the bacteria evolved this unique ability as a result of originating in an environment of deep space, instead of what are normally considered habitable planets, and arrived on Planet Atka aboard a meteorite. Early experiments with the bacteria revealed that their spread throughout an ecosystem habitable by humans is exponential, and that if allowed to reproduce unchecked in such an environment, a habitable planet could be rendered a complete wasteland within decades by the bacteria's ravenous life cycle. This discovery turned initial excitement into frustration as the disastrous impact that the bacteria's introduction would have on planetary environments was fully understood. The terraforming of Planet Atka has been put on hold due to the countereffects that the bacteria would create. The solution to the bacteria's destructive appetite resulted after a research grant contributed by Synth Foods funded a joint team of Planetform and Cryer Pharmaceutical scientists. The Cryer scientists used their latest genetic manipulation techniques to genetically re-engineer the bacteria. An enzyme critical to the bacteria's survival was discovered, and the gene responsible for it's production was isolated and then removed from a breed line of bacteria. The following generations of bacteria were unable to produce this simple enzyme, and died without reproducing unless artificially supplied with a steady diet of the enzyme. A nanotube filtration pack was developed that carries enough of the enzyme to feed a bacterial colony for several weeks. The bacteria are implanted into the nanotube filtration packs, which are then positioned on racks within a filtration system. Waste is then pumped through the racks of filters, and the resulting discharge contains only non-toxic atomic elements. In water purification systems, the discharged hydrogen and oxygen are rejoined into H2O molecules in an electrostatic recombinant process that is in wide use on space stations and large spacecraft throughout Sirius. The bacteria are harvested by Planetform from Planet Atka and are implanted into nanotube matrices, and then sold as filtration systems for air, soil, and water purification systems, and even toxic waste disposal. The filters efficiently eliminate all poisonous or toxic materials by breaking down the molecular structures into more basic elements which can then be recycled or deposited into an ecosystem without threat of contamination. The benefits to space station and spacecraft environmental systems is tremendous, and the cost savings more than compensate for the limited shelf life of the filters. The resulting Xenobiotic Filter product is sold throughout Sirius. Planetform Inc. supplies the genetically engineered bacterial colonies and nanotube filter packs, Cryer Pharmaceuticals holds the patents on the breed line of bacteria that it genetically altered, and Synth Foods secured an "at-cost" 100 year licensing agreement for it's Synth Paste production operations as repayment for it's research grant which funded the product's development. All three corporations are positioned to reap windfall profits from the filters' sales for the forseeable future as biodome communities and population centers retool their waste disposal facilities to use the new filters.

1114412
[818 AS] Slavery Scandal Rocks Corsair Society
1114413
CRETE -- 818 AS -- The Corsair Empire was rocked last year by allegations that human organs from Etna Base that were being supplied to injured Corsair soldiers and ailing citizens of Crete were not being taken from captured Outcasts or fallen Corsair heroes as their final sacrifice for the Empire after all, but were in fact being harvested in a monstrous and wholesale fashion from helpless, enslaved citizens of the other Sirian Houses. The sensational military trial of the so called Etna Six, four doctors and two logistics officers of Etna Base, having concluded with their convictions on all counts, leaves the population across the Corsair Empire to come to terms with the full scope of the traitorous deviousness that existed among them in such a beguiling form. Citizens of Crete who received organs have rushed to their doctors for medical checks, but the medical profession insists that even if organs from slaves were given to citizens, full and complete screenings were conducted before each transplant operation was carried out. So far, while some citizens have insisted that their elective organ transplants be removed, no cases of disease or illness related to transplants from slaves have been reported.
1114414
[818 AS] Anti-Slavery Prosecutions Underway
1114415
CRETE -- 818 AS -- Following the revelations of slavery at Etna Base, laws expressly forbidding slavery have been passed governing the entirety of Corsair territory. The penalties for involvement in slavery range from ten year prison sentences, to execution. Laws regulating the transport of human organs within the Corsair Empire have also been passed, to insure that all such shipments are composed entirely of either organs produced in scientific laboratories, or harvested from voluntary donations. Even after the executions of the Etna Six for their egregious violations of military regulations, rampant rumors persist of slaves being used on remote Corsair bases for vile purposes. The Elders have appointed a special Inspector General, Javier Morales, to investigate all rumors of slavery within the Corsair Empire, and to prosecute all perpetrators to the fullest extent of the laws. While most citizens blame the Outcasts for somehow instigating the activites on Etna Base, many rumors of involvement by the Hessians, Liberty Rogues, Mollys, Junkers, Lane Hackers, and even Zoners also persist. The long term consequences for Corsair relations with these factions are yet to be determined.
1114416
[818 AS] Corsair Butchery Scandalizes Sirius
1114417
MALTA -- 818 AS -- Reports of Corsair atrocities in Omicron Eta are now confirmed. The Corsairs were systematically transporting slaves and prisoners to their lair in Eta and butchering them to harvest their organs. These organs were then provided to the rich and elites of Corsair society as replacements for the damage they did to their own bodies during their privileged and debauched lives. Fallen Outcast heroes from the Eta battlefield were dishonorably stolen by the Corsairs to cover up the source of the illicit organs being moved to Crete. Once the truth surfaced, the Corsairs further attempted to cover up their crimes by staging sham trials to place the blame on "rogue officers" who were in fact criminals already condemned to death. The Corsairs will stop at nothing to spread their lies throughout Sirius. Their renewed propaganda against "Maltese slavery" is merely a diversion from the truth of their own abominations. The Outcasts will continue to offer the poor and oppressed of the Houses an opportunity to come to Malta and live and work honorably for their livelihood, while enjoying the benefits of the Orange Dream for themselves. In stark contrast, the Corsairs defile the honorable dead, murder the innocent out of greed, and slander the noble Outcast nation out of envy. All Outcasts must redouble their efforts to end the rule of the Corsairs over the systems that suffer under their cruel tyrannies.

[819 AS] Okinawa/Sigma-19 Gate Completed
1114676
MIURA -- 819 AS -- Despite many sabotage attempts and material shortages, the Sigma-19 Jump Gate in Okinawa has been completed only slightly behind schedule, which finally allows Gas Miners Guild ships to travel freely between the developing Okinawa system and the mining operations on Ogashawa. 1114677
[818 AS] Prisoners' Plight?
1114678
MIURA -- 818 AS -- A number of disturbing reports have surfaced recently regarding the treatment of prisoners in the uranium mines on the planet Miura. Allegations of physical and sexual abuse are regularly filed with the prison authorities, although it appears that little is being done to resolve the issues. One prison guard, who would speak only on condition of anonymity, stated: "The conditions down here are appalling. The guards are not paid enough for the work they are doing, and the prisoners have it much worse. Most of them are Bretonians, although there are a lot of political prisoners from New Tokyo as well."  In the meantime the uranium shipments continue to arrive at Isehara Orbital Refinery on time, and despite the relatively high turnover of prisoners, more continue to be shipped in from various prison stations to serve as the GMG's cheap workforce.

[817 AS] Kishiro Calls For Calm In The Sirius Market
1114680
MIURA -- 817 AS -- The terraforming of Planet Miura is on schedule as planned, according to several top Kishiro executives who spoke earlier today, in an attempt to calm the nerves of panicky investors after the terrorist bombing of the Sigma 19 Jump Gate project. Stocks in Kishiro plummeted following the terrorist attack, but rose again and stabilised after the announcement by Kishiro Technologies' financial executive, Mr. Yutaka Kinjo.  "This terrible attack on the Sigma 19 Jump Gate has in no way set back the scheduled date for completion of the Planet Miura terraforming project. Shipments of terraforming materials continue to arrive safely and security has been further tightened to ensure the continued safety of everyone working on the project."  Officials from the GMG, who own Planet Miura, could not be reached for comment although it is believed that their security has increased considerably around Isehara since the incident at the Jump Gate.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Located deep in the Concord belt, Beckley is a lightly populated base by Xeno standards. Though seemingly in contradiction with the Xeno modus operandi, the base was founded by a group of radicals who were spared a lengthy sentence on the Wall by a Xeno raiding party which attacked and boarded the liner transporting them. Deciding to champion the same cause as their rescuers, the rebels saw an opportunity to wedge themselves in the path of Junker smugglers, beginning to make frequent usage of the Virginia system's more discreet jump hole passages.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The inhabitants of Beckley now launch frequent raids on smugglers passing through the system, often destroying the ships they find and extracting what remains to further strengthen their position. Their effectiveness as a thorn in the side of the Junkers has lead to increased Rogue patrols in the Concord belt, to take care of the budding nuisance.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Beckley's raiders continue a proud tradition of pulling recruits off of prison liners bound for the Wall and occasionally attract those tired of the straight and narrow on Houston. These pilots also frequently target Navy and Police ships, relying on ambushes and other underhanded tactics to remain competitive with their numerous foes. This has in turn made them the focus of urban legends and other exaggerated tales, used to keep cadets sharp and aware of their mortality.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

The organization managed to successfully lobby the Rheinland government to subsidize Stuttgart agriculture for hundreds of years, generating a huge amount of wealth amongst the farming dynasties and increasing the planet's food output considerably, especially in the growing of Blue Jillies. But with the end of the Eighty Years War in 669 AS and the government completely bankrupted, the subsidies were no longer tenable and were cut almost overnight.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In a secret deal during the war, the Rheinland government desperately borrowed huge sums from Liberty. The Liberty food giant moved in immediately, buying out huge numbers of nearly bankrupt Stuttgart farmers and proceeded to crush entire farming dynasties over the following decades. Some collapsed in suspicious circumstances, such as the Erlichmann family whose farms and plantations suffered a number of sabotages shortly before their buyout by Synth Foods. Much of Stuttgart was subsequently converted into vast expanses of the bioengineered mono-crops of Synth Foods.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The government backed the foreign company wholeheartedly and looked the other way as Synth Foods used unscrupulous business practices to further consolidate its control over Stuttgart. The remaining independent farmers were ultimately forced to lower the prices of their produce in order to compete with Synth Foods, which greatly reduced their income.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The once proud Stuttgart farmers were reduced to indentured servants. Inexorably, Synth Foods assimilated the bulk of the planet's arable land, dutifully paying its Rheinland federal taxes and feeding the bribe machine in New Berlin. The WVS tried to fight back legally in the courts but soon discovered that their influence had been sold to a higher bidder. This sparked a number of sabotage incidents at Synth Food owned factories and it lead to Synth Foods forcing the Rheinland government to replace virtually all of the original WVS board members with their lackeys in 775 AS, destroying the farming union's voice in New Berlin. It was this final act that lead radicals from the WVS, including the former head of the Erlichmann family, to found the Landwirtrechtbewegung ("Farmers Rights Movement"), simply referred to as the LWB, later the same year.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The LWB built a small depot called Darmstadt within the Ostnebel to serve as a base for operations targeted at Synth Foods convoys within Rheinland space. The Red Hessians also used it as way station along one of their routes to Omega-11. Yet as of 825 AS the LWB has begun to self-destruct as more and more infighting takes place between the previously united cells.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Darmstadt Depot itself became a battleground with multiple splinter factions of the dying LWB vying for control of the station. As the situation aboard Darmstadt became more desperate, a handful of hardline members took it upon themselves to put an end to the madness, and in a fit of self-righteous fury the group rigged the stations reactors to blow. Destroying Darmstadt and burning the shattered remnants of the LWB upon the very pyre that first ignited the Landwirtrechtbewegung.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

[816 AS] Terrorism Works
1115484

The Xenos have stepped up their attacks on targets throughout Liberty in the hope of provoking a similar response from the Liberty Government. "We know they are hurting" a spokesman for the Xenos said recently, "For every 3 ships that make it into Liberty, they are losing at least one". The Xenos attacks have recently become Liberty-wide, indicating a degree of organization higher than what was originally believed, Liberty forces, while coping for now are finding themselves increasingly stretched thin by the constant harassment.
1115485
[816 AS] A Problem of Cash Flow
1115486
ALAMO -- Money has always been a problem for the Xenos. A grass roots organization made up of mostly disgruntled lower class workers and their families, the Xenos have never had much of a cash reserve to call upon. Raiding supplements their income, through the sale of stolen parts and commodities, as well as plundering the last remains of silver from the silver fields of Colorado. It is rumoured that they may also have a number of secret beneficiaries within the upper classes of Liberty itself who donate funds and support to the group. Though this has never been proven and no one has ever been formally charged in this area.
1115487
[816 AS] Someone on the Inside
1115488
ALAMO -- Xenos have no shortage of manpower. As the number of dissatisfied workers in Liberty grows owing to the Governments economic policies there, so to do ranks of the Xenos. Their brand of simple politics and nationalism is an attractive drawcard for many among the millions of bitter and angry out of work people of Liberty. The prison stations of Texas also provide a reservoir of hardened recruits, where the Xenos are aided by insiders in the LPI itself, who are always eager to make a quick buck under the table.

Skills which will be needed if they ever hope to achieve their political aims in the face of the stiff and determined resistance from the Liberty military.

1115753
[832 AS] Bautzen Station and Strausberg destroyed!
1115754
DRESDEN -- 832 AS -- A successful blitz attack has been launched against the Bautzen Station by Cruiser Heppenheim and its escort wing! Bautzen Station went down in flames, along with most of its crew - deservingly so for their continued defiance against us. While Heppenheim was lost with all hands to the Battleship Strausberg's immediate counter-attack, it managed to disrupt the enemy fleet long enough for our bomber wings to retaliate. The Strausberg was damaged beyond the possibility of repair, with its cowardly crew scuttling rather than fighting to the death. The enraged Rheinwehr has foolishly sent what remained of their forces to try and destroy Leipzig, but only managing to disable the station before the Kassel and its escorts arrived. Those invaders were promptly dispatched, with operations on Leipzig Station expected to resume in short order.
1115755
[832 AS] Breaking the Stalemate
1115756
PETRA -- 832 AS -- Grinding stalemates against the Hessians in Omega-5 and Omega-47 have gone on for decades, with tens of thousands having met their end in these systems. High Elder Montoya once pioneered the Road to Rheinland strategy to break this impasse. He envisioned an assault through the Sigmas into Rheinland, crippling the Hessian back lines in Dresden. While the High Elder has since passed, today we have the power to once again put his bold plan into action. Our scouts aboard the Battlecruiser Penitence report that the Rheinland Military and Hessians have severely bloodied one another in clashes across Dresden. Both are weakened and preoccupied; all we must do is administer the fatal blow. The Elders have directed our forces to assemble at Petra and prepare to break through Frankfurt into Dresden. Be wary of the Bundschuh, who have harassed our raiders and resupply freighters in the area. They will likely try to stop us, and are to be shot on sight.
1115757
[832 AS] New Threats, Old Foes
1115758
DRESDEN -- 832 AS -- The Red Hessians have attempted to expand their control over the Dresden system. This time, their target was the Bautzen Station, used to extract precious Blue Diamonds, often referred to as "Hessian Tears". Their merciless ambush was so quick, that the Battleship Strasberg stationed in the system was unable to respond in time, and the only survivors was the quarter of the crew that made it to the escape pods before the station depressurized. Strasberg has, however, managed to catch the Hessians before they've managed to slip away, taking out their 'flagship' in quick order. Admiral Schwarz has ordered the forces under his command to press the advantage, and led his forces towards Leipzig, a former Daumann installation that was taken over by the Hessians over a decade ago. The Admiral's quick decision-making allowed our brave forces to heavily cripple the Hessian presence in the system, possibly sufficiently to drive them out of the system entirely.  The victory did not come without a price, however: The main reactor of Strausberg suffered heavy damage during the battle and the ship had to be abandoned after having it's functional components stripped out. Admiral Schwarz in an interview earlier today stressed that the situation in the system is definitely an improvement after the recent events, and that the Hessian defeat in the system is imminent. Yurasu Station
1115949
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Ibashi</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>GRAVITY: Complete</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>DOCKING: Yes</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>AMENITIES: Yes</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: 115</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115950
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Erected deep within the Koryu Cloud in the utmost secrecy, Yurasu is an unusual departure for Samura. In the face of multiple GMG affronts, resulting in open corporate warfare around the periphery of Kusari and the lack of significant Naval Forces presence in the Sigmas, the corporation decided to take matters into its own hands.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Samura's upper echelon paid a considerable sum of credits to the Hogosha and Farmer's Alliance to stage a massive diversionary raid not far from Niigata in order for a number of construction vessels to steal away into the Koryu Cloud, where a supply depot and hangar was hastily constructed over the course of weeks. This depot grew as Samura snuck more and more resources into the system until it grew to present-day Yurasu.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To the best of Samura's knowledge, the Guild is unaware of the station's existence, but the staffers take few risks. Resident Samura employees along with pilots from the Hogosha, Alliance, and occasionally even the Corsairs congregate here in a desperate effort to inflict as much damage as possible to nearby GMG assets. The aim is to create enough pressure here to end or at least relieve pressure from the siege of Kurile.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115951
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Eventually the isotopes we use for H-fuel are going to run out, but to mine out the entire Crow Nebula would take thousands of years at least. We know that these isotopes aren't here naturally - not in this concentration. Projections show that this nebula should have coalesced into stars, but instead the nebula is dispersing. The implications are unnerving. Only a very large star - a blue hypergiant - could have dispersed this much interstellar gas, and given the isotope density, the star did not meet a natural end. If you were a scientist and tried to understand this it would boggle your mind. The force needed to rip a star apart without it being destroyed by the star before it can achieve it's purpose is almost inconceivable, almost. Think about it, the gases that were left over from that explosion have powered nearly all of Sirius for over eight centuries, and we haven't tapped more than a fraction of the Crow.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115952
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Thanks to Kishiro Technologies our ships have been upgraded with many technological innovations. Our Gas Miners are the most efficient in use in Sirius, and we continue to refine our fighter avionics and sensor suites to be able to build on the advantages our combat tactics offer us. This is no small accomplishment.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115953
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>We have shared some of our technologies with the Blood Dragons, who are resisting the Outcasts and other threats emerging from the Omicron region. The most important technologies we have shared with them are our sensor suites, which allows their own fightercraft to be more effective when fighting inside nebulas. This does not help those among the Dragons who would seek to attack Kusari targets directly, but it gives them a significant advantage in systems like Chugoku and Tohoku, where they use the cover of the nebulas.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115954
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>H-fuel is the bread and butter of Gas Miners Guild. We are always trying to perfect the quality of our product, and develop new, more efficient Gas Mining technologies. We are at the forefront of all developments in this field, mostly because we fund the bulk of the research into it. We intend to keep it that way.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115955
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>It really is only a matter of time before we will be ordered to begin work on warships of our own, but I wager they will be a lot smaller than these Rheinlandish monstrocities we captured. The analysis of the Yanagi wreckage has given us a solid understanding of the technologies behind Rheinland capital ship engineering, and we also know a good deal about Kusari warship construction - a parting gift we took from our partnership with Samura in the past. Combining that knowledge with our own is a potent mix of technologies. Question is if they are compatible - Rheinish design favors oversizing everything from armor thickness to weapon sizes. Kusari construction doctrines emphasise form over function. Ours emphasise on pure function, but hasn't gone beyond fightercraft. Choosing a course will be difficult for the engineers.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1115956
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The basic components of H-Fuel are Hydrogen, Deuterium and Helium-3. The amount of Hydrogen to the Helium-3 and Deuterium content determines how enriched the mixture is. Different engines require a different mixture - generally, the bigger the engine or reactor, the purer the mixture can be. Since all the isotopes are stable, H-Fuel will not decay under normal circumstances, and can be stored indefinitely - unlike the fuel Gallia is rumored to use. It will react chemically with oxygen, since a large portion of the fuel consists of hydrogen isotopes. The main gas we mine for in the Crow is Helium-3. It forms as a byproduct of stellar fusion, and isn't normally found in a nebula. Why the Crow is so rich in this isotope has been subject of much scientific debate, but the Gas Miners Guild has built their fortunes on this anomaly. We use more Deuterium then we can extract from the Crow, so we actually import that isotope from elsewhere in Sirius.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Even so, many within the Blood Dragons and the Golden Chrysanthemums visit the nearby Morioka base to catch a glimpse of the spectacular view that the planetoid offers.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116053
Planet Kitahara
1116054
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 13,512 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 6.20 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Terrestrial</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -22°C to 32°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.60 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Originally charted in 655 AS by the Golden Chrysanthemum exploration vessel Hikki Maru, the planet Kitahara was noted for its extreme similarities to Malta, even down to a virtually identical climate and atmospheric composition. Fully habitable with a comfortable surface pressure and an atmosphere that is well within the tolerable limits for human respiration, the planet was eventually settled by large numbers of the Sisterhood and their families in 678 AS, with farms and homesteads becoming commonplace across the planet after only a few years.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Substantial deposits of iron, aluminium and niobium were discovered in the Okimura mountain range on the northern continent by several Blood Dragon planetologists, although it was not until 723 AS that mines were opened to take advantage of the availability of these resources. Initially the work was done by robotic mining machinery and human overseers, but as more prisoners were captured during fights against the Kusari Naval Forces, Farmers Alliance and the Hogosha, they started to be put to work within the mines. Captured female prisoners were either inducted into the Golden Chrysanthemums if suitable or sold off to the Outcasts and Blood Dragons in exchange for Cardamine and supplies.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>By 766 AS, the planetary population was estimated to have reached at least twelve thousand. The majority of the inhabitants were still members of the Sisterhood, but a significant number were also Blood Dragons by now, who had relocated from Kyoto Base to a more pleasant planetary environment after having grown weary of living in space. The Blue Lotus Syndicate even constructed a number of offices and warehouses within the capital city of Yomi, to serve as a base to which to ship Cardamine to the Golden Chrysanthemums, all the way from Malta.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 805 AS, after a convention held in Yomi by many eminent Golden Chrysanthemum and Outcast scientists, it was decided to attempt to seed Kitahara with Cardamine. The planetary conditions were largely ideal and very similar in many ways to Malta itself, so it was widely believed that Cardamine could indeed be grown on Kitahara. Experimental plantations were set up the following year, but unfortunately most of the seeded Cardamine initially died out due to inexperience by Sisterhood farmers in cultivating the grasses. By 809 AS, the Cardamine did manage to take hold in a few areas, but the yields were of horrendously poor quality compared to the Cardamine from Malta, but there was a severe side-effect to the meddling in the planet's ecosystem. The influence of the Maltese orange grass on Kitahara's ecology had begun killing off almost all other native and important crops and with the planetary population in excess of thirty thousand, starvation was looking to be a serious prospect. Many Blood Dragons also became appalled at the Cardamine experiments occurring on the planet and began moving off-world once more, most returning to Kyoto Base, while others moved to the Ryukyu and Mito bases.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To counter the potential starvation issues, the Golden Chrysanthemums have since embarked on the ambitious Chanai Biodome Project, covertly aided by Synth Foods, Inc, while at the same time continuing the Cardamine experiments on Kitahara with the Blue Lotus Syndicate. The Cardamine experiments have drawn considerable interest and outrage on Malta, with many Outcast Dons arguing amongst themselves on the viability and threat of such an undertaking. Some argue that it provides the Outcast people with a fallback safety net should Malta ever be nuked by the Corsairs, while others feel that it undermines their ability to effectively control the entire Cardamine market within the Sirius sector. Nevertheless the Blue Lotus Syndicate, an influential Outcast organisation by its own merits, maintains its support of the venture and has a sizeable presence on the planet.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Battleship Tennessee
1116288
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Initial surveys of the interior shows a relatively intact superstructure and pockets of thin pressurization in some of the more well preserved sections near the service and waste reclamation sectors. Many of the crew and command quarters exhibit signs of indiscriminate and intense struggle. Cursory analysis of the intensive carbon scoring found throughout the habitation decks seem to exclusively correspond to blast profiles of Detroit Muntions Lot E291-F standard issue service firearms, the manufacturer and model of a firearm widely distributed to the servicemen of the Liberty Navy between 492 and 534 AS. While dried blood and small amounts of vacuum preserved human tissue have been found, the initial survey and reclamation teams have yet to find any substantial collections of human remains that can be tied to a specific service roster, but it is possible that this is the Battleship Tennessee, lost during the Texas Incident.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Engineering and Instrumentation sections are entirely depressurized, and show signs of multiple attempts at salvage over the course of many decades. Several generations of derelict breaching pods remain anchored to the hull, while empty breach points show scorching characteristics of emergency thruster burns that are quite unusual in normal detachment and return operations.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
