1116325
RULES
1116326
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>1. COMMUNITY RULES</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>1.1 This is a Freelancer-based role-play community. Character names and behavior must be realistic in the Discovery Freelancer universe (no player nationality tags, memes, pop-culture references, or direct imports from other universes like Star Wars). Realistic role-play also means that characters can't use information they didn't receive in the game universe.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>1.2 Don't insult, harass, or threaten players outside of role-play. Don't use racist, graphic, pornographic, obscene, or law-violating materials in or out of role-play. Don't repeatedly target specific players or groups with the intention of ruining their game experience. Don't mislead players about rules or pose as an admin or "admin friend" to gain an advantage.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>1.3 Everything must be in understandable English. Some non-English words can enhance role-play, but the meanings should be kept understandable to English-only speakers.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116327
Gameplay
1116328
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>2. SERVER GAMEPLAY</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.1 Out-Of-Character (OOC) chat should be avoided in local and system chat. Using // in front of OOC messages is recommended.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.2 A character/ship must use one single ID and follow the permissions and restrictions of ID, ship, and equipment infocards.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.3 Players using Recruit ID and players below level 30 may not be attacked unless they: attack first, fire cruise-disruptors, refuse to stop stalking, carry a codename weapon, or take active part in role-play.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.4 All attacks must be a result of roleplay. Players must say more than one line and give reasonable time for the opponent to react before initiating an attack. Non-Nomads may always attack Nomads, but role-play is still required. See rule 5.1 before attacking a Player Owned Base.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.5 If you die in any way during PvP, you must leave the system the fight took place in and not re-enter it on any characters for two hours. You may not carry cargo, engage in player interactions, or be attacked while leaving. You also can't attack the player(s) you died to on any of your characters for two hours.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.6 The same as 2.5 applies if you dock within 15K of your enemy while in PvP, with the exceptions that you may re-enter the system to trade, keep your cargo, and players may attack you while you're leaving the system.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.7 Demands should be reasonable and only one monetary or cargo demand can be issued during each piracy interaction.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.8 Don't disconnect in space to escape interaction. If you get disconnected, log back on immediately and apologize to the players you were interacting with. If you can't apologize ingame, do so in the forum thread titled "DISCONNECTED". Don't rejoin a fight without permission from your adversary after getting disconnected.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.9 Connecticut is a system where players aren't required to role-play and may only attack with the adversary's consent. Bastille is a system that imprisons rule breakers until they agree to obey server rules.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116329
Bounties
1116330
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>3. HIRED GUNS AND BOUNTIES</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.1 All contracts and bounties must be justified within roleplay and conform to IDs. A character may be hired ingame or on the forum by non-generic IDed (non Freelancer, Pirate, or miner) players, for a minimum of 1 million credits per target. Targets must be informed of the contract/bounty originator before the attack. The reputations of employer and employee must be neutral or friendly to each other, and they must both be hostile to the target.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.2 Bounties and contracts made while the employer is offline or PvP-dead must be posted in the "Bounty Offices" sub-forum. Employers must specify their name and affiliation, and also specify and verify the affiliation of those who may claim the bounty. A limited payout number, expiry date, or exclusivity to pre-registered bounty board members may be specified beforehand. Players may not hire exclusively their own characters.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.3 Forum-Bounties on factions instead of named individuals (blanket bounties) may only be issued (or sponsored within roleplay) by official factions and governments. These may also be compensated through flat rate payments of at least 30 million credits per month to individuals or factions. Non-generic IDed unofficial factions may sponsor internal blanket bounties for members of their player or NPC faction only.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.4 Attacking someone for non-existing contracts or non-claimable bounties, as well as not visibly claiming payment within 7 days of an alleged forum-bounty kill, will result in sanction. Payments must be made within two weeks of a legitimate claim.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116331
Factions
1116332
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>4. FACTIONS</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>4.1 Players may create a faction for any publicly available ID they want, if the faction uses a single ID, IFF, and tag. Every faction must have one leader and at least one second-in-command who speak for it. It's recommended but optional for unofficial factions to post descriptions in the Unofficial Factions and Groups sub-forum, explaining their background, diplomacy, goals, and to ask for community feedback. It's also recommended to create roleplay message logs on the forum.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>4.2 Official status is awarded following the "Achieving Official Faction Status" post on the forum. Official Factions (OFs) must have a public feedback thread they answer to on the forum. They have the following Official Faction Rights (OFRs). All instances of OFR use must be documented by forum roleplay.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 1: OF leaders ranked first or second in command have in-roleplay authority over characters of the same NPC affiliation, regarding diplomacy and strategic/tactical direction. They may not require anyone to follow non-canon or unreasonable roleplay. Disobeying legitimate orders may result in roleplay consequences such as ingame arrest, court-martial, and in extreme cases ingame force.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 2: OFs who planned an event with at least 24 hours notice on the forum can restrict the participation of others in that event. It shouldn't severely limit another faction's activities in their own ZoI or provide unfair protection from logical roleplay consequences.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 3: OFs may request that the reputation of a player's ship be set hostile towards their NPC faction, by posting in the appropriate Violation Reports sub-forum. They must provide evidence of forum roleplay and interaction between the OF and the character. Ships subjected to OFR3 may treat ships of the issuing faction (except transports) as hostile targets.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 4: OFs may bounty or attack a player who uses their affiliation's technology without the faction ID nor official permission, regardless of their diplomacy with the user's faction. Permissions may only be given by an OF affiliated with the manufacturer of the technology, and must be documented in roleplay on the forum.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116333
Bases
1116334
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>5. PLAYER OWNED BASES</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>5.1 Dealing more damage to a Player Owned Base (POB) than needed to prevent a ship from docking must be preceded by forum roleplay and a post in the Attack Declaration Thread at least 8 hours (core 1 bases) or 24 hours (core 2 and higher) prior to the attack. Attack declarations are valid for 2 weeks.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>5.2 No roleplay is required prior to building a Core 1 base, but it must make sense in roleplay. Name, location and IFF of bases are permanent and can't be changed after construction. Bases within 15k distance of mining fields may not advance beyond Core 2. Core upgrades have requirements listed in the "Player Owned Base Upgrades" forum thread.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>5.3 POBs are destructible when unprotected, so it's recommended you inform yourself about House laws and fees and local diplomacy in order to build in a well protected location. POBs in systems bordering House space may not be engaged by House forces for lack of payment of fees, but can still fall prey to other factions.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116335
Cheating
1116336
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>6. CHEATING</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The following cheats and exploits are forbidden:</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.1 Modifying your Discovery Freelancer installation, using third-party tools, or abusing glitches/bugs in order to gain advantages over other players.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.2 Running the game with framerates above 155fps. Computers running uncapped framerate must use a third party program to limit the FPS to below 155.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.3 Using cruise disruptors or missiles in order to track a ship that has successfully cloaked.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.4 Intentionally ramming a capital ship in order to ''flip'' it or ''catapult'' your ship away from it.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.5 Suicide trading and intentionally self/team-killing during Combat-Event-Plugin battles in order to prevent the opponent from scoring points.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.6 Connecting to the server with more than one character at a time (Multiboxing). Players sharing a network connection may not engage in trading/mining at the same time.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>
1116337
Sanctions
1116338
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>7. SANCTIONS</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>7.1 Administrators will impose sanctions on players who violate rules or harm server gameplay. Admins are obliged to:</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Safeguard the community, server, and forums.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Be fair and treat all players equally.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Not mix server roleplaying with server administration in any way.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Not ignore reported rule violations.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>7.2 Depending on severity and amount of rule violations, sanctions can range from a warning, credit fine, loss of equipment, probation periods with removal of certain privileges, and bans of varying duration. Sanctions will appear in forum threads detailing the offenses and punishments.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>7.3 If someone shows disregard for the rules even after being informed of rules and violations, players can file a rule violation report in the appropriate sub-forum. Playing Discovery Freelancer as a community is less anonymous than other games, and therefore things are often taken more personal. Don't attempt to use violation reports for personal revenge. If you're angry, take time to gather and present the evidence properly and make sure you're not mistaken when you're calm.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

1116410
[826 AS] University Of Cambridge Chancellor Is Missing
1116411
CAMBRIDGE -- 826 AS -- The Chancellor of the University of Cambridge was reported missing last month by the Vice Chancellor. Professor William Mortimer was reported to have been on Planet Gran Canaria at the time of the nuclear explosion that occurred last month following the failed negotiations that took place prior to annexation. Police say they are following several leads, although the current situation within the house and the Omega-49 system may delay the investigation "We believe that the disappearance of the Chancellor is likely to be politically motivated" A police spokesperson said earlier, adding "Because of the situation in the Omega-49 system, the Bretonian Police Authority is working closely with Armed Forces personnel on the ground to examine whatever evidence may arise". Professor Mortimer was known to have been a supporter of the Zoner position in the Annexation and was not on official business at the time of his disappearance. Police are appealing to the public for any leads.
1116412
[826 AS] Annexation Of Gran Canaria
1116413
GRAN CANARIA -- 826 AS -- Following the recent detonation of a nuclear device on Planet Gran Canaria and the failure of Bretonian diplomats to secure an agreement from the local Zoner population, the Bretonian Government has authorized the annexation of the planet. This comes after years of tension as the system was well known to have supplied and aided Corsair and Molly raiders. Now with the Gallic Invasion reaching New London, the patience of the Bretonian Crown has reached its end. Unwilling to allow the removal of the planet's Corsair population, the Zoners chose to resist the advances of the Bretonian diplomatic corps and as a result the Annexation began in force last Monday with all major settlements falling to the Bretonian Armed Forces within a few days. While sporadic resistance continues, the Armed Forces, along with elements of the Bretonian Police Authority report success in pacifying most of the population.  While the Order have publicly condemned the annexation and promised to defend Zoner interests within the system along with the Corsair Empire, other local groups have remained uncharacteristically quiet with only the Hessians launching a propaganda campaign in order to boost their numbers.
1116414
[826 AS] Battleship Beuvray Destroyed
1116415
NEW LONDON -- 826 AS -- The looming siege of New London is not as inpenetrable as Gallia likes to claim. In December last year, our brave allies from the Republic of Liberty made a daring sally into the Gallic Trinity at Southampton. Losses were suffered, but ultimately the Gallic battleship Beuvray was destroyed, together with most of her fleet.  Recently it was reported that the Beuvray had been replaced by the Athos, a Corsair battleship. This confirms the existence of the Gallo-Corsair alliance. Contrary to what Gallic admirals might think, this is a gain for us, because they now rely on an ally who we know is unreliable. [825 AS] Kusari Declares War! Speech by Yukihara Reijiro, Prime Minister
1116421
NEW TOKYO -- 825 AS -- No more than a month ago I addressed this Noble House with our intention to bring a new future to this new region of space, this new member of our family of stars. Shizuoka. Before that, we of Kusari expressed concern and sadness upon witnessing the discord that had befallen our neighbors of Rheinland, and the corporate heads of the Gas Miners Guild, that threatened the stability of the region and could eventually put in danger our House and our people's way of life.  With effort, we established a security corridor linking to Rheinland, and pledged to both conflicting sides that we would do the utmost to prevent the bloodshed in the Sigma-59 system, ensuring free traffic and relief from the strains of war that would engulf the rest of the sector, unless the House of Rheinland made efforts to sit at the negotiations table with the Guild to settle for peace. We hoped for intelligent heads to prevail, to see the demerits of a prolonged war, of a vague quest for vengeance and grievances that were well below the amount of wrath that the Rheinland spirit demonstrated. We expected that they would know who they were looking for, fighting for, defending from.  We were ignorant. No, Kusari demonstrated a naiveite that has become too common in its complacency. By believing in our apparent strength and the pride we hold for ourselves, we made ourselves victims to Rheinland Military, who blinded by bloodshed, had forgotten who was their enemy. From seeking justice to just meeting any other human being they found on the battlefield with their destructive force, they struck. And they struck those who held no blame.  On the past day, KNF local forces had confirmed our suspicions that the Rheinland Military had indiscriminately attacked and annihilated joint Kishiro and GMG civilian installations part of the Shizuoka Colonial Commission project to colonize the Planet Saigon, as it is commonly known. Neither Kishiro or GMG units were of military flair, and all transponders were clearly identified as a civilian operation, just a dozen clicks away from KNF sanctioned security corridor. It is with sadness that we have confirmed the death of Commissioner Akemi Yamashita, senior Kishiro executive and well known promoter of Kusari economy and society development for many years.  Rheinland Military, without quarter, attacked these installations, destroyed these peaceful efforts for progress. They ignored the pleas for mercy, and then expected the Kusari Naval Forces to stand idle before this onslaught. They were not idle.  Upon confirming the destruction of Kishiro Survey Vessel Unzen, Kusari Naval Forces took the initiative of retaliation against RM breach of the peace of the Shizuoka system, and notified the government of these horrible crimes. The Diet of Kusari has just now through its processes condemned the actions of the House of Rheinland, validated the Naval Forces actions of retaliation, and pressed further.  By decision of the Diet of the Reformed Kusari Empire, and by the name of our august Emperor, the House of Kusari has entered a state of war with Rheinland. Such state and any special provisions related with it will remain, until Rheinland ceases all military activities in the Sigma cluster, agrees to withdraw from the Shizuoka system, and accepts the necessity of sitting down to negotiate peace with the Gas Miners Guild and the people of Kusari.  Furthermore, due to the crisis situation in the Shizuoka system, the mandate of the Shizuoka Colonial Comission is suspended for a yet undetermined period, and the control of the affairs of the system placed under the military command of the Shogun Ikeada Yamato, as commanded by the Emperor.  We hope that our people remain strong and vigilant against the threats to our House, and that together we prevail against the challenges ahead of us. Kusari will prevail.

[826 AS] War Over Curacao
1116440
CURACAO -- 826 AS -- The Allied Forces struck a costly, yet decisive blow to the Gallic Royal Navy today, after a multi-day protracted battle over the shipping lanes of Cortez and, ultimately, the fate of those desperate for supplies on New London.  Allied operations were undertaken by a combined task group of the Liberty's Alma and Yukon battlegroups, as well as the Bretonian's Harlow battlegroup, with light support from the Crayterian Military. Arrayed against them was the Gallic battleship Betheny and its attendant craft, as well as a raiding party of Corsairs who came to the Royal Navy's aid shortly into the fight.  The Gallic battleship Betheny was the latest in a long line of attempts by the Royal Navy to significantly hamper the supply lines of Libertonian war materiel entering Bretonia. Even with the deployment of Liberty's Yukon, relief supplies were just as likely to be seized by Gallic raids or destroyed outright as were to safely travel make it into Manchester. The Alberta-Poole jump corridor had made the route largely supplemental, but with the loss of that corridor and the ever-growing threat of New London coming under siege, this long-brewing stalemate became an intense focus for the war planners on both sides, and the Allies were the first to act with the deployment of the Harlow and Alma into Cortez.  The first few days of battle proceeded at range. The battlegroups' smaller, lighter craft fought over and over in a large-scale stalemate between the deadlocked warships, each side hoping to gain the advantage in indirect fighting. After the fourth day ended in another inconclusive draw, however, the Allied Forces recalled their lighter craft and readied to enter into a close range engagement. According to representatives from the Liberty Navy, the Allies had feared the Betheny might escape should they delay further, or that an unseen savior might come to rescue the vessel before it could be put to rest.  The charge was led by the Libertonian battleship Yukon and its attendant battlegroup. The Alma followed not so distantly in its wake, with the Bretonian Harlow bringing up the rear. According to a source within the Allied military command, the captain and crew of the Yukon moved to engage ahead of the scheduled assault, believing that the Betheny was preparing to withdraw before they had planned to attack.  The resultant clash could be seen quite clearly from Curacao's surface, a spectacle which has already lit up the social neural-nets. The Yukon and Betheny engaged in a close-quarters melee, duelling with high-powered weaponry. The Alma quickly moved in to bracket the vessel, attempting to take her down before the Yukon suffered critical damage. The Harlow, however, remained outside the effective range of the Betheny's main cannon, offering primarily bomber support against the Gallic capital ship from distance.  Despite the valiant efforts of the Allies and the Royal Navy, however, both the Yukon and the Betheny fell to hostile fire with all hands. The vast majority of the Betheny's attached battlegroup were destroyed outright, although some managed to escape deeper into the system, along with their allies in the Corsairs. A good portion of the Yukon's escort elements were also lost before they could be reinforced by the Alma's, and the surviving remainder under Rear Admiral Jack Yeager have since been attached to the Alma pending reassignment, Navy representatives told the CNS. Both Harlow and Alma themselves suffered non-critical damage in the fighting, and they have been noted to be receiving materiel from naval logistics vessels in Curacao orbit since the fighting ended.  A joint allied statement has called the operation an unequivocal success, whilst simultaneously lamenting the lives lost, especially aboard the Yukon. Representatives from Orbital Spa & Cruise were quick to applaud the cessation of fighting within the sector, and told the CNS they were hopeful that this would be the start of Curacao's rebuilding and growth after being struck by the war so directly. For the first time in over three years, traffic advisories posted by Interspace Commerce have dropped to "caution", the lowest level posted since the destruction of San Diego Border Station. For those watching the skies on New London, this news comes none too soon.  We will keep you updated as the situation throughout the war front develops. This is the Colony News Service.  War Correspondent Alexander Cooper

After a decisive assault, the Bounty Hunters fled the system to cower behind the skirts of their Military paymasters, followed not long after by the skeleton force the Police could muster. Scouts reported a fleeting sighting of the Battleship Karlsruhe near the Norddrauwolke Field, but no engagements with Military forces were recorded.  While the Hessians have secured a great victory in denying the Imperialists the system, the Revolution is still beset by foes. The barbaric Corsairs have seized the moment to launch a renewed offensive on Hessian holdings in Omega 47, and forces from Gallia are beginning to launch patrols into Cologne through their newly constructed Jump Gate.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Amorgos satellite is locked into a slow orbit of the greater Mykonos Gas Giant, but rotates rapidly on its own axis. With a thin Oxygen-argon atmosphere with pockets of dinitrogen monoxide, the air on Amorgos is barely breathable for short periods. For many years the prospect of colonization was deemed unfeasible because of intense dust storms and hallucinations induced by the high concentration of dinitrogen monoxoide in the moon's atmosphere. Due to the heavy casualties incurred by previous manned expeditions, the Council of Elders on Crete formally forbade further survey missions to take place on the moon in 803 AS.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>When deep scans from more powerful survey equipment developed by Cryer brought the wealth of ancient alien ruins beneath the surface to the attention of the Corsairs, the Council of Elders lifted their no fly restriction on Amorgos and colonization, though difficult, began in earnest. Working the artifact mines is lucrative, and for those who prefer a more honest and less dangerous trade, there is still much work to do helping to reinforce and expand the growing colonies of Amorgos.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>With the rapid expansion Amorgos has seen, there have been rumors of a backroom deal between Cryer and the Council of Elders for funding of the moon's colonies. These Corsairs are just as willing to flee into the mines and collapse the entrances behind them as they are to form a firing line, and with their knowledge of the moon's intricate tunnel networks it is unlikely that the insurgency they'll surely present would be easily subdued should Amorgos ever see the Core's troop transports blacken its sky.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Kruger - Space-based Mining Operations
1116920
ESSEN - Active Kruger Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   Kruger has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Bautzen Station - Dresden: Diamond mining in the Schwefelwolke. Bautzen is one of the oldest mining operations in Rheinland, harvesting clear diamonds from the Schwefelwolke asteroids. Recently, new deposits have been located in the southern end of the nebula, still suitable for mining.  Elbich Mining Facility - Omega 7: Silver and Cobalt mining operation in the Walker Nebula. The Omega-7 region of the Walker nebula is rich in mineral resources. Kruger has established the Elbich Mining Facility north of the Jump Gate to Stuttgard and staked claims northeast of Elbich.  Wuppertal Refinery - Cologne: Aluminium mining in the Wildspitze. The Wuppertal refinery is a joint project between ALG and Kruger. The base is not yet fully operational, but mining operations can already be initiated. The nearby Wildspitze field, northeast of the base, posesses a good quantity of Aluminium.
1116921
Daumann - Space-based Mining Operations
1116922
THE RING - Active Daumann Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   Daumann has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Solarius Station - Omega-11: Diamond mining in the Riemen Von Rohe. Solarius is our primary diamond mining operation. Diamonds float freely in the ring around the red giant. Be aware of the intense radiation throughout most of the system. A heavily armored mining ship is recommended. Daumann has placed marker buoys near greater concentrations of diamond-bearing asteroids.   Briesen Mining Facility - Omega-7: Copper and Cobalt mining operation in the Walker Nebula. The Omega-7 region of the Walker nebula is rich in mineral resources. Daumann has established the Briesen Mining Facility south of the Jump Gate to Stuttgard and staked claims south of Briesen.  Rugen Station - Omega-3: Hydrocarbon mining. Rugen, located south of the Omega-7 Jump Gate in Omega-3 is our primary source of raw hydrocarbons. The heaviest concentration is found south of Rugen Station itself.  Raubling Station - Munich: Aluminium mining in the Chiemsee fragments. Raubling was located close to the Chiemsee before the Munich disaster, but the asteroid field has fragmented since then. Two dense portions remain, one located southwest of Passau Station, and one northwest of Ingolstadt. Daumann has laid claim to both of these fragments.
1116923
Bretonia Mining and Manufacturing - Space-based Mining Operations
1116924
THAMES - Active BMM Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   BMM has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Graves Station - Dublin: Gold mining in the Dublin system. Dublin has been the primary source gold for Sirius for over 400 years, and this isn't likely to change any time soon. Graves has several active mining operations, but the most commonly used field is to the southeast of the base.  Cambridge Mining Facility - Cambridge: Beryllium Mining. The Cambridge system has an extensive asteroid field north of Planet Cambridge, rich in Beryllium. A new station, which at the time of this writing has not received an official name yet, is being established to initiate mining on this field.  Douglas Station - Omega-3: Hydrocarbon mining. Douglas, located south of Planet Nottingham in Omega-3 is a major source of raw hydrocarbons. The heaviest concentration is found south of Douglas Station.
1116925
Samura Industries - Space-based Mining Operations
1116926
SHINJUKU - Active Samura Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   Samura Heavy Industries has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Sapporo Station - Hokkaido: Helium-3 Gas Mining With the Gas Miners Guild no longer supplying Samura, we have seen fit to resume our own Gas Mining operations in the Hokkaido system. These our based from Sapporo, and can be found east of the base.  Planet Tomioka - Tottori: Platinum Mining. The Shirane planetoid has a debris field surrounding it which has proven to be rich in Platinum. Astronomers are unsure whether this planetoid will remain in Tottori as of yet, so Samura has not built a permanent mining facility. Instead mining craft can be serviced at Tomioka, and ore shipped elsewhere for processing.  Shinkaku Station - Tau-29: Hydrocarbon mining. The Shinkaku field is a good source of a variety of organic compounds, ranging from nitrates to hydrocarbons. The best hydrocarbon deposits are located in the northwest part of the field.
1116927
Kishiro Technologies - Space-based Mining Operations
1116928
SHINEGAWA - Active Kishiro Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   Kishiro has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Gas Miner Ogashawa - Sigma-19: Helium-3 Gas Mining Our partnership with the Gas Miners Guild allows us to operate our own Gas Mining operation within the Sigma-19 system. Kishiro's gas miners are located northeast of the Ogashawa.  Nago Station - Tau-29: Hydrocarbon mining. The Nago field is a good source of a variety of primary hydrocarbons. The highest density is located northwest of the station.
1116929
Deep Space Engineering - Space-based Mining Operations
1116930
PITTSBURGH - Active DSE Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   DSE has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Camrose Supply Depot - Alberta: Platinum Mining Scouts in the Alberta system have found a midsized asteroid field in the far north of the system rich in Platinum. While collection is fairly easy, the remote location of this field does not make it easy to reach.  Philedelphia Station - Pennsylvania: Silver mining Also a rather remote location in the Pennsylvania system, the Wilkis-Barre asteroid field in the far northeast of the system contains small amounts of silver. Yields are not as high as those reputed in the Omegas, but the field is still a valuable asset.
1116931
Independent Miners Guild - Space-based Mining Operations
1116932
ALAND - Active IMG Space-based Mining Operations, for guildsman reference.   The IMG has the following opportunities for miners: Java Station - Tau-23: Niobium and Beryllium Mining Gallia has thus far tolerated our presence in Tau-23, so our operations in the system are going on as usual. There is Beryllium in the southeast, and Niobium in the northwest, both in dense asteroid pockets.   Falkland Base - Tau-37: Niobium Mining Falkland is our most remote mining outpost. Beware of a heavy Outcast presence if you launch from this base. The main field in Tau-37 is in the west of the system.   The Hood - Dublin: Gold Mining The Hood, famous for it's racetrack, is also host to our gold mining efforts. Expect badmouthing from BMM and the occasional Molly and Corsair raiders if you visit Dublin. Main mining fields we use are northeast from the Hood.  Cardiff Station - Cambridge: Beryllium Mining Cardiff is our main Beryllium mining operation. The mining effort is north of the base, behind the planet Cardiff orbits.   Freistadt Base - Omega-7: Copper, Silver and Cobalt Mining Omega-7 is extremely rich in resources. The IMG has established claims on several smaller fields northwest of Freistadt, from which Copper, Silver and Cobalt are harvested.
1116933
Gas Miners Guild - Active Gas Collection Operations
1116934
AOMORI - Active Gas Mining Operations, for employee reference  The Gas Miners Guild maintains operations in the following systems: Sigma-13: A cluster of miners still operates east of the protostars. The Sigma-13 resources however have been on the decline for years, and the recent increase in Corsair and Outcast activity makes this mining operation a risky one.   Sigma-19: The Sigma-19 system is expected to be viable for several more centuries. Our partner, Kishiro, also has a smaller operation established in the system. All operations are based out of Gas Miner Ogashawa. Our main effort is currently focused to the south of Ogashawa. Hogosha and Outcast raiders pose a threat to these operations.   Okinawa: Our most recent endeavour, Okinawa has a major gas mining operation centered around the Fujisawa facility. The highest concentration is currently in the southern end of the nebula, so our operations focus there. Be aware of the volatile nature of the nebula around Fujisawa however - strong shielding is recommended.
1116935
Gallic Metal Service - Space-based Mining Operations
1116936
ALESIA - Active GMS Space-based Mining Operations, for employee reference.   GMS has the following operations which are in need of additional employees: Toulon Mining Facility - Provence: Niobium mining in the southern end of the Camargue field. The Camargue dustfield is rich in various precious metals. While the Toulon facility refines a number of these, Niobium has been found in sufficient concentration for direct mining operations. The richest deposits are in the southern end of the field.  Indochine Outpost - Tau-23: Beryllium mining east of the base. The Tau asteroid fields seem rich in various metals. The Royal Navy has seized a Bretonian mining operation in the system labeled Tau-23, which was mining Beryllium. We can now begin exploiting these resources ourselves. The field is located to the east of the base. It is easy to find - simply follow the trail of Bretonian wreckage.
1116937
Junker Scrapper Scoops
1116938
ROCHESTER - A scrapper scoop for all you scrappers out there. Here's where the good stuff is.  Texas: Good old 'Tex has been a boon for Junker scrappers for almost 200 years, and that ain't changing any time soon. Sure, most of the good stuff that was easy pickings has been picked, but there's still plenty, if you know where to look. And you'll have to look inside the dark, menacing Negra clouds. Plenty of Premium Scrap pieces there, but the radiation can be bad. Ye'll need a heavily armored ship for scrapping in that mire. The boys at Beaumont will fix you up if you take some damage.  New London: Southampton's been churning out refuse for centuries, and those Brets weren't too keen on "recycling" until quite recently. So there's plenty of still useful stuff. The Southwest section of the debris field is usually the best spot - ask around on Trafalgar.  Bering and Hudson: Unexpected opportunities. When the Rheinies blew the gates and wrecked a few Liberty heavies in the process, they left that pile of wreckage just sitting there. Liberty doesn't seem to be in a hurry to make repairs either. Their loss. Our gain. Scoop up the good stuff close to the gates, but keep an eye out for Xeno raiders, they seem to think they own those places.

[813 AS] Tensions Rising between Kusari and Bretonia
1117079
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 813 AS ]]  NEW TOKYO -- In a press release today Kusari officials have condemned Bretonia once again for the scale of the Bretonian Armed Forces build up in the Tau systems, after new information has emerged showing Bretonian warships stationed near Holman Outpost, a peaceful IMG installation in the Tau-31 system. Bretonian patrols were spotted as far as Tau-29, prompting fears of possible Bretonian annexation on the Kusari public. IMG officials have expressed regret over this course of action and continued to press for a peaceful resolution, despite already being pressed by obvious Bretonian colonialism. In response, Queen Carina I of Bretonia has officially attempted to explain these actions by pointing the blame at the honourable Kusari Naval Forces who have stalled for as long as they could in the face of a Bretonian military advance. She further continued spreading lies about Kusari material support for Bretonian eco-terrorists.  In response, the Kusari government has officially put out an order to rally the Naval Forces in preparation for a possible Bretonian attack. The Tau-29 system is shortly expected to be declared as part of a Kusari protectorate to ensure the system's continued independence from Bretonian military ambitions. The protectorate will also encompass the lawless Tau-23 system in order to assure the safety of Kusari territory.
1117080
[812 AS] Tensions Rising between Bretonia and Kusari
1117081
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]  NEW LONDON -- Peace in Sirius sector is under threat once again. The militaristic Kusari government supported by Hogosha criminals is doing everything to destabilize the situation in Tau space. Previously the only enemies that Bretonia had to deal with in the Tau systems were the Outcasts and the Gaians. Now however it appears that there is a new, more dangerous enemy - the Kusari Naval Forces. If that wasn't enough, the Queen's government has recently recovered proof that the Gaian eco-terrorist movement is being supplied directly from Kusari.  In response, New London launched an attempt to negotiate on the fragile Tau situation with Liberty as a mediater, an attempt which was repulsed by the Foreign Ministry of Kusari. This immediately launched concerns that the Kusari government is trying to provoke a full-scale war with Bretonia. The Queen's government refused to officially acknowledge this until proof had been produced of a Kusari military buildup in Tau-29, when hundreds of Kusari destroyers and gunboats have been spotted entering neutral Tau space.  To secure Bretonian borders, the Bretonian government ordered an increase in Armed Forces presence in the Tau-31 system. Armed Forces will concentrate on securing Bretonian holdings in the system, but will remain clear of the other Jump Gates within Tau-31. A Bretonian official commented on the situation: "We hope dearly that Kusari does not try to push this diplomatic failure into a war, for it will cost many lives. Bretonia will not bow to this sabre rattling and our forces will remain on orders to hold fire unless the Kusari Navy openly strikes us first".
1117082
[812 AS] Coalition Formed Against Corsair Expansion
1117083
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]  BUFFALO -- Since early 812 AS tensions have been steadily rising between the houses of Bretonia and Kusari, and it is expected open war will break out soon. What was less than expected however was news of Corsair involvement. A few weeks ago the Corsair plot was uncovered by Outcast operatives: the Corsairs and their Hogosha allies are attempting to use their influence on Samura to steer the Kusari government into open war with Bretonia! While the reasons for such a move are unknown as of yet, many speculations have emerged, including a possible renewed Corsair offensive on Cambridge while the Bretonian Armed Forces are busy elsewhere, and perhaps even a renewed strike on Outcast holdings in the Omicron systems in an attempt to tip the scales in the long war.  Word has also came in of many factions now supporting the Corsairs in their move, including the Gaians in Bretonia and the Farmers Alliance movement in Kusari. This has immediately prompted a call for a summit on the issue, and today marks a breakthrough in the proceeding talks as a majority of Liberty Rogue, Lane Hacker and Molly leaders officially came together on Buffalo base to sign an alliance with the Outcast nation. The Junkers have also expressed their support, and in Kusari the Blood Dragons and Golden Chrysanthemums have invited Outcast representatives to discuss long term plans. Outcast leaders have stated that they hope this to successfully tip the scales in their favour and nip the Corsair threat in the bud.

In other news, reports of an increase in pirate attacks on the fringes of house space have Libertonian analysts working over time. A connection seems to be implied between the rapidly increasing Kusari aggressiveness, an influx of artifact trade coming in unchecked from Shikoku and these pirates. Libertonian government officials reported they will be looking into the matter.

1117378
[815 AS] War in Tau Space Continues
1117379
MANHATTAN -- 815 AS -- Fall of 814 AS will be remembered as the first time the nations of Sirius saw a hope for peace between Kusari and Bretonia in the War for Tau-31, when in a surprising move Kusari offered a six month truce to Bretonia, which was quickly accepted by the Queen's government. Analysts were quick to point out that the attrition of Bretonian fortifications at Harris and the skilled use of the Leeds Jump Gate choke point continued to put great pressure on the Kusari Naval Forces which now needed time to consolidate and protect their gains from frequent and frenzied pirate attacks. At the same time Bretonia lacked the strength to accomplish a breakthrough against Kusari lines. The ensuing stalemate and the following truce proposal seemed like an excellent opportunity for lasting peace negotiations.  It was thus all the more shameful that the peace process broke down so quickly. Only two months into the truce, at the beginning of 815 AS both sides began gathering forces at each side of the Leeds gate in an attempt to dissuade one another from any surprise attacks. Within two more months fighting broke out once again after Bretonian forces broke the truce by engaging Kusari forces in Tau-31 through a surprise attack using the jump hole from the Dundee system followed by the main strike from Leeds. However, despite Bretonian initial gains the Kusari Navy held the fort. Bretonian forces suffered heavy casualties during the Leeds break out, a loss they would be hard pressed to recover from.  The fleet striking from Dundee had more success, having taken the Kusari forces at Holman Outpost completely by surprise and inflicting heavy casualties. It was not until reinforcements from Tau-29 arrived, that Kusari has repulsed the attack and forced the Armed Forces in Tau-31 to retreat to Harris once again. During the battle itself Holman Outpost was heavily damaged by Kusari battery fire. Several independent miners were killed; an act that prompted an apology from the Kusari government, but did nothing to demilitarise the area around the station. Kusari Naval Forces continued to use Holman as a staging area, despite IMG requests to the contrary.  With the truce broken and any hope of a quick peace in shambles, the war for Tau-31 rages on. Kusari continues pressing its goal of complete Bretonian elimination in the Tau systems, while the dogged defenders of Harris continue to stand in the face of a naval blockade. Time will only tell how this conflict will finally end.
1117380
[815 AS] Bretonia Breaks Truce
1117381
NEW BERLIN -- 815 AS -- The war for Tau-31 continues. The six month truce offered to Bretonia by Kusari was broken this week by the Bretonian Armed Forces, after the latter launched a surprise attack on the Kusari staging area at Holman Outpost in an attempt to cripple the Kusari defenders. A previously unknown jump hole was purported to have been used in the breakout attempt, though the attackers were in the end unable to hold the offensive, and were forced to pull back to Planet Harris before further Kusari reinforcements reached the system, thus effectively lengthening the war by many months. Twenty eight independent miners have also been reported to have died due to collateral damage as a result of the attack. The Kusari government delivered a quick apology for the incident, but continued pressing the need for a militarisation of the space around Holman in the face of unexpected Bretonian attacks on the area.A spokesman from the Rheinland government said: "We share the concerns of the IMG regarding such a move, I think it is safe to say we can expect only an escalation of violence in Tau-31 as a result of this Bretonian attack".
1117382
[819 AS] Outcasts Safe in Tau-23
1117383
CALI -- 819 AS -- The invasion of the Gallic naval fleets into Orkney and Tau-23 were cause for uncertainty among many Outcasts. But since then, we have learned much about their capabilities and intentions. The Gallic forces are bound for Bretonia, and in their wake follow many supply shipments, which provide an opportunity to seize materials much closer to Malta then ever before. The Gallic forces seem unaccustomed to fighting within the dense asteroid fields of the Taus, but it is second nature to our own fighters. They are however better equipped than the miner vagrants that call themselves the IMG.  It is in our best interests to inflict as much damage on the Gallic forces as possible. Should Bretonia fall, Gallia may decide to attack towards Genoa instead, and that would eventually put Malta itself at risk.
1117384
[815 AS] War Without End
1117385
NEW LONDON -- 815 AS -- In a recent address to the nation, Queen Carina has called for the Bretonian people to "stand firm, patient and courageous in the face of Kusari aggression" after the treaty that was supposed to last six months at the minimum was broken after only four. Bretonian Armed Forces officials cite the reason for renewed hostilities as "the need to respond to the Kusari naval build up preparing to strike on Leeds", with government officials rallying to the opinion that Kusari government was planning to break the truce regardless so that they can push their advantage into sovereign Bretonian territory.  The truce was broken after Bretonian forces moved through a previously unknwon system into Tau-31, bypassing Kusari defenses at the Leeds gate and seizing Holman for a couple of hours before Kusari reinforcements arrived at the scene. Despite the attack not making any significant gains, the Bretonian Armed Forces reports that the strike allowed them to reinforce both Planet Harris and BMM holdings in Tau-23, further strengthening the defensive lines. The war is expected to continue in full capacity for months to come.
1117386
[815 AS] Bretonia Attempts to Strike Back
1117387
CRETE -- 815 AS -- Yet another treacherous strike marks Bretonia's history today, as the Armed Forces moved into Tau-31 in an attempt to catch the Kusari navy unprepared, and broke the cease fire that was supposed to last for months more. Kusari forces have rallied fast and repulsed the attack, but the damage was already done: more Bretonians now reinforce Planet Harris, which will make the war even more drawn out than it already is. A quick resolution is now all but a myth.  The attacking Bretonians revealed one of the jump holes they have been using to communicate with Tau-31 through this however: the so called Dundee jump hole was used to transport a large attack force behind Kusari lines, and after that attack was routed the Kusari fleet quickly moved through it to engage the remaining Bretonian forces there and seize the choke point. Should they manage to win in the system, Edinburgh should be up for easy grabs.
1117388
[815 AS] Bretonia Breaks the Truce
1117389
NEW TOKYO -- 815 AS -- The Bretonian government has once again proved their incompetence and treachery by breaking the peace treaty and attacking Kusari Naval Forces in Tau-31 just two days ago. The treaty having been proposed by the honourable Kusari government was made last year in the name of promoting an end to the vile conflict in Tau-31, and was supposed to last for six months - yet was broken after only four. The Kusari government has been swift to respond by making it explicitly clear that peace is out of the question in the face of the constant militaristic threat that Kusari is facing, and that the Bretonian government must be unseated for any peace process to be able to occur. A Naval Forces spokesman mentioned Kusari forces having found a "new way into Bretonia, one that will allow [Kusari forces] to fight on an even more equal footing". He further added that the war is expected to progress into core Bretonian systems within a matter of months.
1117390
[815 AS] The Legacy of the Nomad War
1117391
NEW BERLIN -- 815 AS -- Although the war instigated by the traitor Niemann has been over for almost 14 years now, echoes of the conflict continue to shake Rheinland society as it struggles to rebuild its former power after the abject defeats during the many battles of 801 AS What remains a mystery however is the unexplained disappearance of the survivors of the battlegroup that attacked Honshu. Accounts from the conflict itself seem to confirm that the Military fleet made great initial gains against the Kusari navy but was eventually pushed back and forced to retreat to Sigma-13, where the surviving forces seemed to simply disappear into the gas clouds.  Statistics show no less than hundreds of ships going missing in the aftermath of the War of 800 AS that were never accounted for since. This mystery kept on baffling historians and analysts: could it be possible that the battlegroup's officers were more loyal to Niemann than to their Fatherland? A connection was made when a rising spate of pirate strikes on the edges of Rheinland space turned out to actually be terrorist attacks by what seemed to have been Rheinland pilots flying older generation Military ships. In the wake of such attacks the inevitable question was raised: could Niemann and his cronies have returned to plague Rheinland once more?  These attackers have quickly earned the nickname "Die Wilden" or the "Wild" by the survivors of their attacks, owing to a supposed feral attitude and lack of mercy for military personnel and civilians alike. In response the Rheinland Military was officially briefed on action against such traitorous attacks, such that it continued to steadily protect the nation and themselves. Nonetheless, little is known about the group or their ultimate goals. All that is taken for granted is the fact that these so called "Wild" shoot to kill, take no prisoners and are extremely dangerous, and that any who encounter them would do well to attempt escape toward the nearest Military strong point immediately.
1117392
[819 AS] Independent Miners in Tau Space Threatened
1117393
SOUTH SHIELDS -- 819 AS -- The annual South Shields conference concluded today, with attendees discussing the future of the IMG in the Tau region. The Bretonian/Kusari conflict caused the deaths of at least 65 miners, most of whom perished when Outpost Holman was hit by Kusari fire during a Bretonian raid. With Gallia's shock arrival, some are calling for an evacuation of Guild personnel. Others note that only Rheinland corporations could employ so many on short notice, and many Guildsmen came to the Taus to escape those companies. The conference concluded with a reaffirmation of the IMG's neutral stance in the conflicts, and a commitment to maintain work while adhering to the civilian law of the House which has local military control.

[816 AS] War in Tau-31 and Dundee Set For Stalemate
1117421
NEW TOKYO -- 816 AS -- The war over Tau-31 continues to rage on, meanwhile Naval Forces commanders have abandoned their plans for immediate offensive into Leeds over allegations that the government is sending too many forces abroad, leaving the homeland exposed to pirate attacks. The admiralty has instead opted for a tactic of entrenchment in Tau-31, devoting present standing forces to crack down on smugglers running the blockade to Harris and Tau-23 within the system for as long as further reinforcements from Kusari are delayed. When asked whether it is a wise move to give the Bretonians ample time to prepare, a spokesman for the Naval Forces responded: "the Bretonians have nothing and they know it. The only thing they can do is delay the inevitable".  Kyushu, Tau-29 and Tau-23 have reported a record number of pirate attacks in the last quarter, with a great likelyhood of these attacks being funded by the Bretonian crown. These new measures by the Kusari navy are expected to help stamp this presence down once again.
1117422
[816 AS] A New Threat in the Omega Sector
1117423
CADIZ -- 816 AS -- The Bretonian-Kusari war is set to last far longer than the Corsair Elders initially expected. The initial expectations of a swift, surprise conquest of Tau-23 that would cripple the Outcasts at the start fell terribly short, and gave the opposing factions time to rally together to oppose the Corsair plan by putting their mutual issues aside and uniting against them. That not being the end of it, a new enemy using unknown, exotic and extremely dangerous brands of weapons appeared suddenly within core Omega space, dealing noticable losses to both the Red Hessians and standing Corsair forces, making it look as if the fates had conspired against the Corsairs in every way possible.  Thus, the order to consolidate has been given. The conquest of the Outcast homeworld is no longer considered as the main objective. The Outcasts have heavily fortified the Omicron Eta system, to the extent that head on assault is no longer feasible. With Rheinland openly criticising Liberty and vice versa, any future conflict between the two may lead to the Red Hessians relocating more of their forces to the Omega systems, and forming a critical mass that may even threaten Cadiz and Leon bases. Whatever happens, the Corsairs will be prepared. The Elders are ready to wait for their time to strike one of the many Corsair enemies, and at least a few of them will be weakened enough soon so that they can be finished off.
1117424
[816 AS] Bretonia Keeps Borders Safe
1117425
NEW LONDON -- 816 AS -- Despite the hard push by Kusari naval units, the Bretonian Armed Forces has kept the border safe with not a single Kusari strike managing to break through the line so far. The Kusari assault on Dundee was broken and forced to retreat back into the Tau-31 system. The Leeds Jump Gate remains secure with a Bretonian build up keeping the space safe on the Leeds side, while the defenders of Harris continue staring down the besieging Kusari navy with neither side willing to advance into the mine fields separating them.  The war is set to descend into yet another lengthy stalemate, although some analysts are set in their claim that this situation is simply "the calm before the storm". Not content to just disregard such claims, the Armed Forces continue to fortify the borders hoping to be prepared for any kind of Kusari attack long before it happens.
1117426
[816 AS] Sirius Wide War on the Horizon
1117427
MALTA -- 816 AS -- The war between Bretonia and Kusari continues as expected. Neither house is ready to give up, with the Bretonians hoping the attrition on the Kusari forces will force them to give concessions, while the Kusari navy stays firm with its assurances of an ability to breach Bretonian defenses. Both are locked in a stalemate at the moment, although Kusari is expected to eventually breach the lines even if at great cost.  In the mean time past rivalries between Liberty and Rheinland suddenly begin to flare up once again with Rheinland's public accusations of unsanctioned Libertonian research taking place in a hidden system. The Rheinland Foreign Office officially blamed the newly elected President Powell for this research, claiming they have proof to back it up, yet have still so far refused to release any files pertaining to the situation. Furthermore, several rumours of a purported Nomad control over a great many Liberty Navy officers have been spreading across the neural net almost unchecked. One can only assume what the answer from Liberty will be at this point in time.
1117428
[816 AS] Rheinland Media Blast Powell for "Unethical Research"
1117429
MANHATTAN -- 816 AS -- Liberty officials have been rushing to rebuke claims by the Rheinland state media that the Liberty Navy is pursuing unsanctioned and extremely dangerous research on alien technology, despite similar activities already leading to one Sirius wide war not 15 years ago. When asked for his statement on the situation, President James Powell responded: "This is a wholly ridiculous claim. The Liberty Navy has never possessed alien technology or artifacts, nor has it done research on them. This is simply yet another attempt by Rheinland to bash this presidency for pushing for the remainder of the Stuttgart debt to be repaid sooner, and I for one will not stand idly by while they try to instigate a pointless witch hunt to discredit us".  The Liberty government has also officially responded by stating that claims of the Liberty Navy being infiltrated are unfounded, as the LSF has been heavily involved in screening every individual holding high positions within the Navy structure since the end of the Nomad War in order to prevent any future possibilities of an armed coup. Meanwhile, the Rheinland state media is set to publicly release a documentary on the subject within a matter of weeks, possibly further exacerbating the crisis.
1117430
[816 AS] Stalemate in the Tau Sector
1117431
NEW BERLIN -- 816 AS -- The Tau sector looks set to be embroiled by war for years to come, as both Bretonia and Kusari turn to stationary defenses with only minor direct engagements taking place while they consolidate their forces once again. The Kusari government however is set to once again achieve the upper hand if the decision to transfer further forces from the core Kusari systems is made. In the mean time, Bretonia revels in their small victory in Dundee where they repulsed an equal Kusari force back to the Tau-31 jump hole and successfully held it.  No matter the outcome of the war, it appears clear that the IMG will be the losers. Faced with either Kusari military occupation or Bretonian sanctions against Holman on charges of collaboration, the independent miners are faced with a difficult position of attempting to balance between two strong forces. Holman itself has become virtually abandoned as a result of the war, with only a skeleton crew remaining after the most recent incident where a misfired blast hit the station's hull and killed several crew members. If the war drags on for a few years more, the station is quite likely to be eventually left derelict.

[816 AS] Liberty Into Research On Aliens?
1117435
HAMBURG -- 816 AS -- It is a matter of public knowledge that the Liberty government is as opposed to alien artifact trading as any government in Sirius. But could the actual truth be different? An unnamed source in Liberty has provided a great amount of insight into the forbidden forays of the Liberty government: an effort to import alien artifacts and carry out forbidden research, wholly against the Charter of the Colonies.  According to the information sent by the source this initiative was started by President James Powell, a strong supporter of Libertonian "military power", at the onset of his term. Since then Liberty has not only amassed a strong, militaristic buildup of Naval forces, but has also secretly imported thousands of supposedly defunct alien artifacts -- a fact that has been quite simply concealed from the public. Considering it is well known that the only documented source of such nomad technology is placed deep in the edge worlds in the form of a notorious pirate empire, it can therefore be concluded that Liberty has since established a relationship with these unlawful brigands, likely to the detriment of both Rheinland and Bretonia.  Then there is the research on live specimens. According to our source, Liberty has allegedly procured a number of live alien hosts several years ago, using which its scientists successfully performed extensive research on the alien genome, going so far as breeding them in laboratory conditions and experimenting with human-alien hybrids! News of this have left Rheinland government officials in complete bewilderment: has Liberty already forgotten the folly of experimenting with alien technology, and the effect it had on the crazed Chancellor Niemann? Right now the possibility of President Powell already being under the influence of alien artifacts is considered by the Rheinland government as quite real, and the recent increase in Liberty patrols and checkpoints on the Liberty-Rheinland border has prompted a similar response from the Rheinland state. State officials have already responded they will be attempting to establish the legitimacy of the Liberty source before further action is taken.
1117436
[819 AS] Omicron Eta Still Stalemated
1117437
FREEPORT 9 -- 819 AS -- Since the Omicron Eta system was discovered for the first time, it was destined to become the "no man's land" between the Corsairs and the Outcasts. Providing quick access to both Omicron Alpha and Omicron Gamma, both sides were quick to fortify the system on their own respective ends, and fighting has continued inbetween ever since. In response to the constant attempts at deeper incursions, both sides began spreading stationary mines between the nebula and Planet Catania. Eventually the last Zoners from the inhabiting the system left, and the result was a battlefield split in two by a large field of stationary mines, deadly to any who would venture inside.  Both sides continue fighting over the system, though locked in a stalemate. The superior skill and abilities of Outcast pilots are evenly matched by the numbers the Corsairs employ in their pursuit of conquest. It is without doubt that to conflict in Omicron Eta will carry on for many years more before any conclusion is reached.

[819 AS] Unioners Warming To Corsair Influence
1117439
LEIPHEIM -- 819 AS -- Despite the risk of a rift with the Red Hessians, the Unioners in the Munich system are once again cooperating with the Corsairs. So far the Hessians seem to tolerate the cooperation, so both the Unioners and Liberty Rogues are likely to be making a fortune in smuggling both Artifacts and Hessian Tears into Liberty.

[817 AS] New House Joins The Colonies
1118104
JAVA -- 817 AS -- The remote system of Orkney which is part of Bretonian space, although it is not considered part of Bretonian territory, has become a site of events that will change the history of the Sirius sector forever.  On day 320 817 AS, 1704 Manhattan time, a massive explosion was sighted by local Independent Miners Guild patrol in an old mine field. First it was thought that the explosion was an accident. Later, however, several consequent explosions followed. The explosions cleared a wide pass within the mine field that lead to a previously unknown jump hole. From the jump hole, a large fleet of unknown ships came through the passage between the mines and ventured into the clear area of Orkney. IMG first considered them to be unknown aliens and brought warships from Dounby Station in case their intentions were hostile. However, very soon IMG ships were contacted by the newcomers who identified themselves to be representatives of the lost French House, bearing the Latin name of Gallia.  Gallia has been aware of existence of Sirius Houses for centuries but, however, chose a path of intentional isolation. The fleet of ships that breached the mine field belonged to a group named the Council, a political and military opposition of the Gallic central government. It took many years of fighting for the Council to suppress the powerful defenses of the Gallic Navy and reach the mine field. Now, isolation is a thing of the past, and Languedoc system to which the jump hole from Orkney leads can be freely visited by any ships from any Sirius Houses. Systems beyond Languedoc are still under control of the Gallic Navy, and the Council warns everyone willing to explore the distant Gallic systems that forces loyal to the Gallic government have most likely received an order to attack any unknown ships on sight.  Shortly after breaching the mine perimeter, the Council began to construct a space station not far from the mine field using hull components brought from Languedoc. The station was named Reunion, not only after an island in the Indian ocean that belonged to France until the year 2088 A.D., but also as a reminder of what happened on 320 817, day that will be remembered in history as the Day of Reunion.

1118117
[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part I
1118118
710-716 AGS (794-800 AS) -- Some historians name the year 798 as the beginning of the Second Gallic Civil War, for that was the year when the Council acted openly against the Gallic Army for the first time. Yet it is commonly considered that the war started in 794 AS on Planet Marne located in the Champagne system, when a massive rebellion broke out in three out of five of Marne's prime industrial centers. The rebellion was apparently well-prepared and organized. Gallic media reported that many rebel commanders were former military officers or even professional criminals hired to fulfill this task. Those reports were denounced by the Council, but it is apparent that there were a number of experienced soldiers and military commanders among the rebels. Initial tactics involved taking control over the main Marne cities and industrial facilities with minimal destruction and civilian casualties.  At fist, the rebellion was an overall success: police forces in the cities were defeated, as well as army detachments recently deployed within the cities to preserve order. However, most Gallic ground troops resided on well-defended bases in desolate areas of the planet. Their resistance was much heavier than the rebels first expected. Despite numerical superiority, rebels were heavily outgunned and could not establish control over the planet's terrain. At first, the government hesitated to use heavy weaponry against the cities. Rebels used this time to reinforce their defenses and capture space ports which were used to deliver weaponry and reinforcements. Light military vehicles and artillery were mainly supplied by the Council, while Gallic Brigands supplied firearms and ammunition. During this time many volunteers from the Council, various pirate groups, and even citizens from other planets joined the rebellion. The space around the planet was controlled by the Gallic Navy at that time, but the Navy apparently underestimated the amount of help the rebels were receiving from off-planet. Patrols assigned by the Navy were not enough to isolate the planet.  Attempts of the army to capture any of the rebel-controlled cities and settlements failed, much like the rebels themselves failed to take control over military objects. In the middle of 798 AS, a large army of over 110,000 troops was assembled in the Core Worlds and prepared for transport to Marne. Only about 45,000 made it through, for the Council finally interfered and attacked incoming Navy forces near Reims station and planet Sezanne. These were the first of many space fights that occurred during the war. The Navy was caught completely unprepared, and had to retreat. The Council failed to destroy any of the transports carrying the troops, but prevented them from proceeding to Marne.  The ambush near Reims happened before the Council forces landed on the planet, although some sources state otherwise. The Gallic Army, reinforced by fresh manpower, launched a massive attack against the rebels, striking on every front. After that, the rebels were probably aware that the Council would arrive in a matter of days, and threw all their forces to defend space ports where Council transports could land. The Council, however, could not break through the planetary blockade soon enough: they had to capture Reims Station in order prevent the Gallic Navy from striking from behind. Once Reims was captured and reinforced with heavy anti-capital-ship weaponry, the Council fleet proceeded to planet Marne. Attacking forces of the Gallic Royals were scattered by the newly arrived Council units, but resistance did not end until 801 AS when it was perfectly clear that the Gallic Navy would not be able to break through Council defenses, at least for the next several years.
1118119
[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part II
1118120
717-724 AGS (801-808 AS) -- After the fight on Marne was over, the war was mostly fought in space and on space stations, with the notable exception of a large-scale ground operation on Planet Quillan. Marne and Quillan are responsible for over 90 percent of all war casualties, which are estimated at 105,000 from both sides of the conflict (numbers are for year 816 AS and don't take into account later events). After overtaking Marne, the primary goals of the Council were securing the whole Champagne system and eliminating any Gallic lawful presence there, and preparing the attack against Lorraine and Languedoc. By the year 803 AS, the entire Champagne system was under control of the Council. The next obvious target was Lorraine. The Lorraine Jump Gate was located only one Trade Lane away from Marne, and in 803 AS the Council assembled a large fleet to attack the system.  It was unknown to the Council that the Royal Navy was preparing for this attack, aware of the final goals of the Council to gain access to the mine fields. The Navy used an alternative route from the Core Systems to reinforce Lorraine's defenses. Council High Command realized its mistakes only after the Navy had launched an offensive against the fleet in Champagne in the beginning of 804 AS, scattering the forces preparing to attack Lorraine just days before the attack was scheduled to start. Casualties from both sides were very high, with over 12 battleships and hundreds of smaller vessels completely destroyed. Nevertheless, daring Gallic Navy admirals ordered an advance on Marne, thinking that they had destroyed all Council capital ships in the system. Near Marne, they were engaged by a large defensive fleet quickly assembled of what was remaining of Council forces, heavily reinforced by Maquis and reportedly even Brigands. With the Trade Lane behind them consistently disrupted by smaller support crafts, the Navy was completely surrounded. Fierce battle continued for several hours before the Council gained the upper hand. Only a handful of the Royal Navy ships escaped. The rest were destroyed or captured.  The forces of the Gallic Royal Navy in Burgundy could not aid their Lorraine colleagues, for they were attempting to fight back the Council raiding parties that appeared in every part of the system with even more regularity than pirates. By that time, Council High Command had already moved from Macon Base in Burgundy to Marne. Macon has become a primary place for Council military preparations, overcrowded with new recruits coming from Marne, as well as weapons, equipment and ships produced in Champagne and in other systems. Due to fights taking place in Burgundy and Lorraine, Navy numbers in Languedoc and Languedoc became much smaller than before the war had started. Additionally, both Languedoc and Languedoc did not contain any defensive installations that the Navy could use to delay the offensive, with the exception of Montpellier Guard Station defending the Languedoc Mine Field.  By the end of 806 AS, Council was fully aware of this weakness and had prepared a multiple-step operation that involved attacking Languedoc, capturing or destroying any Navy ships that would oppose them, and quickly proceeding to Languedoc to complete their initial goal of creating a path through one of the mine fields. A surprise attack against Languedoc would disrupt Gallic communications and allow large fleets of the Council to pass from Burgundy to Languedoc. At the same time, a plan of a covert operation in the Lorraine Mine Field was being prepared.
1118121
[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part III
1118122
725-728 AGS (809-812 AS) -- The plan of the Languedoc offensive developed by the Council did not work as well as initially expected. In 809 AS, Council sent a large fleet into Languedoc to secure the area of Bourgon-Jailleu Station. Bourgon-Jailleu proved to be a tough target, equipped by multiple defensive systems and providing cover for numerous Police patrols that deteriorated the progress of Council fleets. In the end, Council decided that the station had to be destroyed. A diversion was prepared to distract Police ships to the Burgundy Jump Gate. During the diversion, the Council launched its bombers and very heavy fighters against Bourgon-Jailleu that now had only a few ships to defend it. After the defensive systems of the station were eliminated, a Council heavy transport on autopilot was directed into the station hull, destroying the station and killing over 120 Police and Navy officers. The number reportedly includes a few civilians as well.  In the same year, one of the most controversial events of the whole Second War followed. Gap Station, which occupied a crucial location on the route from Burgundy into Languedoc, was attacked by the Council. Because destroying the massive and heavily guarded station that had many civilian inhabitants was not an option for the attackers, their goal was to drop marines within the station and capture it with minimal casualties. Once again, the plans of the Council became known to the Navy command, and Gallic Army detachments were brought to defend the station. Eventually, a large Council fleet arrived to the Gap area, neutralized station defenses and launched dropships. Fighting within the station lasted for more than 4 days and ended only when all Council landing troops were defeated. The victory cost both sides greatly, with over 400 killed and many more wounded. While the Gallic soldiers were stationed near the airlocks to prevent a new assault, a large Royal Navy fleet finally arrived to breach the blockade. Before retreating, desperate Council ships launched a final missile attack against all Gap's airlocks, which could have potentially resulted in the station de-pressurizing. Gap Station's engineers had to seal the inner airlocks before the Gallic soldiers could escape; trapped outside, they were blown into space and perished. Very few of the military and police personnel survived the attack, and civilian casualties were low only by a miracle.  With no chance to capture Briancon or Gap stations located in the central part of Languedoc, the Council chose the tactic of sporadic raids to distract Navy and Police patrols from outer regions of the system that were used to relocate Council fleets into Languedoc. By the end of 812 AS, Council had built multiple storage banks and small repair facilities near the Jump Gate path between Languedoc and Languedoc. Most of those facilities were equipped with simple but deadly self-destruct mechanisms that activated when Navy or Police ships were approaching. The next year, an offensive against Languedoc was set to begin.  Meanwhile, the situation in Burgundy and Lorraine was under dense control of the Navy. Security of the two systems was declared the highest priority for the GRN, and most available forces in the Gallic Border Worlds were ordered to defend them. Attempts to breach defenses in Lorraine failed repeatedly, and Council presence in the system remained minimal. Maquis secured a small base in one of the Lorraine asteroid fields, but they could do nothing with the Navy fleets and mostly concentrated on smuggling and piracy against small corporate shipments.
1118123
[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part IV
1118124
729-731 AGS (813-815 AS) -- The Languedoc offensive caught the Gallic Royal Navy completely unprepared. Apparently, their previous means of gathering intelligence on the Council failed them. A massive armada of Council capital ships came into Languedoc directly through the Jump Gate, which was not guarded by any Navy ships at that time. At the same time, hundreds of Council fighters began advancing from the Lozere asteroid field in Languedoc. Local Navy detachments delayed capital ships advancing to Remoulins, which gave the station's inhabitants time to evacuate. It was rumored that the Council allowed this intentionally to avoid civilian casualties, for most of Remoulins' inhabitants were miners employed by Gallic Metal Service.  The decisive battle for Languedoc took place in the middle of 813 AS near Remoulins. The station was empty at that time, and during the fight one of its outer storage tanks filled with explosive fuel was damaged by battleship fire. The tank detonated shortly afterwards, destroying the whole station. It remains unknown which ship damaged the tank, since Council and GRN used similar types of weaponry in this battle. It is also unknown if it was done intentionally or not. However, it is certain that the explosion helped the Council to achieve a victory, for Royal Navy cruisers that used the station as cover from Council battleship fire were crippled in the explosion and became easy prey for Council bombers.  Nimes Station was the next target, and in 814 AS the Council attempted to use the same tactic that failed with Gap Station. This time, however, previous mistakes were taken into account. The Council made use of inside support from civilians loyal to its cause. While Council fleets were stationed next to Remoulins' wreck and Nimes was preparing for an assault from space, a group of Council special operatives breached the station through a maintenance airlock that was left unguarded. Before local Police and Army guards could organize any resistance, the Council took over control of the station's life support, computer mainframes, internal and external defensive systems. Later, a Council fleet arrived, and station defenders had no other choice but to surrender. With minimal casualties from both sides (4 men killed), this operation is known as the most bloodless in the whole Second Gallic Civil War.  The Council offensive on Planet Quillan was the second planetary operation of the war. Capturing the planet was vital for the final success in breaching the mine field defenses. Breaching planetary defenses was a relatively easy task. However, after Council ground forces landed on the planet in the end of 815 AS, they discovered that a Gallic army of 90,000 was stationed on the planet and prepared to defend its settlements and factories. Outnumbered, the Council forces had to fortify their positions and prepare for a lengthy fight for the planet's surface.  This moment was crucial for the whole war. The Royal Navy was planning to launch a counter-assault against Council in Languedoc. If the Navy's assault was successful, the Council would lose ground in Languedoc and fail to breach the mine field. TheCouncil suffered heavy casualties, and launching a new offensive was not an option until losses were recovered. During that time, the Navy could concentrate all forces near Champagne and take back the system, undoing all progress that the rebels had made since the start of the war.
