[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part V
1118126
732-733 AGS (816-817 AS) -- In 816 AS, the Council had no option other than to request support from the Maquis, who, in turn, rallied their allies in the Core Worlds to attack Royal Navy from behind. While it was impossible to stop the whole fleet that was moving to Languedoc, Maquis succeeded in using terrorist tactics to bomb several battleships of the GRN offensive fleet. An array of brutal and merciless attacks from Maquis and Brigands against civilian convoys followed shortly afterwards, forcing the Navy to relocate resources from the Languedoc offensive to local security tasks.  Now, with the Navy's progress slowing down, the Council gained more freedom to act in Languedoc. Moving the last reinforcements from Burgundy, the Council established lines of defense near the Languedoc Jump Gate, wreck of Remoulins, Nimes Station, and Quillan itself. More Council troops landed on Quillan, increasing the numbers of Council corps on the planet to 95,000. The Council soldiers were mostly unemployed Marne workers, badly armed and trained. They would be no match for Gallic Army in open combat. However, the Council used a waiting tactic and successfully rallied local miners to aid its cause. Army detachments were stationed in the miner settlements, causing numerous conflicts between miners and soldiers. In several settlements, the unrest turned into rebellions aided by the Council. Overtaking settlements one by one, the Council slowly advanced, and in the beginning of 817 AS the remaining Gallic Army soldiers were scattered and forced to surrender.  In the end of 816 AS, the Council finally gathered a large fleet to attack Montpellier. Being the largest fleet ever brought to battle in this war, and possibly the largest fleet ever assembled in the whole Sirius sector since its colonization, it was opposed by a matching number of Gallic Royal Navy capital ships, fighters, support crafts, and stationary defenses. For several weeks, fighting next to Montpellier continued; at the same time, the Navy advanced from Languedoc and breached the Council's defenses near the Jump Gate.  It was too late to retreat at this point, and despite very heavy casualties, the Council advanced to the mine field, destroying numerous weapon platforms, smaller supplementary mine fields, and hundreds of enemy ships. A large part of Montpellier station itself was destroyed in a suicide attack by a Council battleship packed with thermonuclear explosives, with most station defenders killed in the explosion or shortly afterwards. Path to the mines was now clear, and Council moved forward to destroy the mines and create a large corridor that would allow all ships, even the largest ones, to pass through without being at risk of mine explosions. After the path was ready, the Council started to build a new space station on the other side, baring a symbolic name of Reunion.  At the same time, using the aid of local Maquis and several Junker turncoats, the Council started to set up a covert path within the Lorraine mine field. With the Royal Navy relocating all available forces to advance into Languedoc, the part of Lorraine that was far from the Champagne Jump Gate was left loosely defended. Finally, by the end of 817 AS the path to the Outcast system of Omicron Tau was revealed. Unlike the route in Languedoc mines, Lorraine's path was narrow and dangerous, having no navigation buoys nor other ways that could help to make this route safer. It is still likely that it will be discovered by Gallic Royal Navy patrols in a matter of months, and will possibly be remined.

This is done to prevent the intruders from reaching densely populated areas of Gallia. Without sufficient knowledge and navigation maps, pilots of the newly arrived ships will not be able to find alternative ways into the Core Worlds.  The measures that we undertake now are temporary, and very soon we will ensure complete safety for all law-abiding citizens of the Gallic Border Worlds. Please stay tuned and await for further announcements  -- Burgundy Royal Navy Headquarters, Planet Nevers, August 17, 733 AGS

SOLARIUS -- 817 AS -- Although much of the Omega sector is obscured by the encompassing Walker Nebula, there are some parts that can be visible to long range telescopes. Plans for an expedition to the Omega-58 system were delayed due to the ongoing conflict with Rheinland, but have been shelved indefinitely following the unexpected cessation of all energy emissions of any kind from Omega-58. The star has gone dark without the typical supernova shockwave one would expect from a dying star. This has led scientists to speculate the star is either being obscured, or has met an unnatural end.

The Commonwealth settled on the borders of the Republic following the rebellion of Drake Thastus and his battlegroup from the Liberty Navy in 800 AS with the intent of reclaiming their House from an overreaching expansionist government, it's corrupt incorporated police force, and its criminally invasive intelligence agency.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>These early Insurgents soon recognized, however, that their goals of overthrowing Liberty's government would not be accomplished overnight. With this realization they went on to form the Commonwealth, a separatist government embodying the ideology of their movement. Although they continue to conduct frequent operations against the Republic's military, police, and intelligence assets as they remain at war.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>While this contrast to the early actions of the Insurgency rooted in outright rebellion and terrorism has drawn the attention of Libertonian citizens and foreign nations alike, a large degree of stigma still exists towards the Insurgency, and it may be some time before they and the Commonwealth are recognized as a legitimate entity in Sirius.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The fifth sleeper ship, the Hispania, launched at the same time as its sister ships and broke through the Coalition blockade in the Sol system. Unfortunately, sabotage by Coalition agents that had secreted themselves onboard crippled the engines just as the vessel arrived in the Sirius sector. The passengers awakened from their cryogenic sleep to discover the ship was drifting towards an unknown star system. When the Hispania drifted within range of a red dwarf system, conflict aboard the ship escalated, and about half of the surviving colonists decided to take escape pods, chancing their survival on the promise of a habitable world. The remaining half coaxed the damaged vessel onwards to its eventual destination in the Omicron Alpha system, arriving some time in the year 41 AS Upon their arrival, the crew discovered a planet capable of supporting human life in orbit of the primary star. The Hispania's passengers named the planet Malta -- a harsh place of acidic oceans, gray skies, and vast plains covered in a species of tall, thin, orange grass. Taking whatever equipment they could salvage from the crippled Hispania, they left the hulk in orbit of Malta and began to make a home for themselves on Malta.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Eventually the Outcasts -- as they came to think of themselves -- began a limited exploration of their home system. As pilots wandered farther and farther afield in search of resources, many became seriously ill. Upon returning to Malta fall, the crews recovered quickly. After making a number of genetic scans of critically ill pilots, the doctors made a startling and disturbing discovery. Their genetic code had been altered considerably. The Outcast human DNA was found to contain strands identical to that of the orange grasses that covered the planet -- from which the drug Cardamine was derived. Trace amounts were present in everything on the planet, in their food, their water, even the very air. Once pilots made lengthier journeys away from Malta, their bodies went into shock, followed by death.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Outcasts were now truly separated from the rest of humanity -- changed so that they could never expand beyond the planet on which they had landed. They needed the Cardamine now, like air, food or water. But with the origin of the sickness solved, they could at least compensate by carrying supplies of Cardamine with them and resume their exploration of their surrounding systems. Over time, their knowledge of Cardamine improved, and the Outcasts learned that distributing it in a highly concentrated dose causes extreme euphoria. When they finally encountered the rest of the Houses in the seventh century, a new strategy emerged. The Outcasts would deliver the poison that would rot the other Houses from the inside out and grow rich from the profits of their trade.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The planet's crust is largely devoid of usable metallic elements, with a few notable exceptions, namely at the heart of her largest continent, and highly unusual deposits of metallic Copper on the ocean floor. Most of its land mass is covered in prairies with natural, low-grade Cardamine grass; large plantations with heavily bred and modified strains have been built on the most fertile sites. Malta's architecture is a largely low-hung and flat, one-story affair in the rural areas; cities are an expression of extremes, built almost entirely in the rare hilly regions of the planet. There is little at ground-level, except starports; most structures are built both deep into the ground and into massive towers that reach towards the sky, constructed yet again as to mimic the textures of the ground. Malta's oceans are strongly acidic and home to algae that tolerate it's high acidity. They appear to hold a slightly green tint from the surface.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>These days the Outcasts conduct a lucrative drug-smuggling operation using the network of Jump Holes to escape detection and transport their product into the heart of the House systems through various proxies. They remain relatively few in number; a crash in the birth rate seems to have been another side effect of their genetic modification, although the modifications have lengthened the Outcasts lifespan and physical resilience considerably. There have been no known cases of cancer on Malta since the Outcasts made planetfall.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A new development has been Cryer's continued efforts to create a synthetic version of Cardamine that would be approved as a legal medication within Liberty. This poses a direct threat to the Outcasts' source of income. The Atka Research Station, with nearby access to Edge Nebula clouds, is the most immediate threat to the Outcasts. The location of the base within Corsair territory has brought the Outcasts into conflict with their ancient brethren. The Atka Research Station has come under repeated attacks by Outcast raiding parties in recent years, and the Outcasts always destroy any Cryer transports encountered throughout Sirius without mercy.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

1118391
[817 AS] Bigger Things At Stake
1118392
ARRANMORE -- 817 AS -- Kusari wastes no time in smashing the broken Bretonian Armed Forces before them. They pushed through Tau-31, ignored Harris and went straight for Leeds. Molly leaders are well aware of the danger this poses, but it appears like Bretonia is set to fail even despite Molly help at Harris. Seizing Dublin holdings is thus the only thing left to do before the inevitable Kusari victory. Of course it would be far preferred by everyone if the Kusari did not win. Newcastle Molly clans are expected to continue helping the Armed Forces behind enemy lines, and chances that such behaviour will be discouraged in any way by any clan leaders are quite slim.
1118393
[817 AS] A New House Unveiled
1118394
BRUCHSAL -- 817 AS -- Our extensive information networks have today provided us with news that can only be described as unprecedented. A new House has been revealed by a group calling themselves "The Council", supposedly a revolutionary group fighting against a corrupt government and corporations - just like ourselves. While brothers in arms are equally welcome regardless if they operate on the other side of Sirius, the rest of their message was far bleaker: the House government they fight against is about to send an assault of grand scale into Sirius with intent to conquer. Kusari seems to be right in its path, and Bretonia soon after. Only time will tell however if such an action will even take place.
1118395
[817 AS] Down With The Outcast Alliance!
1118396
VOGTLAND -- 817 AS -- The Outcasts finally reveal their treachery. We have suspected them of infiltration attempts in our movement, hoping to gain a foothold in Rheinland through which they can peddle their drugs to our society. Groups within the Red Hessians have been working silently against this, but required proof to be sure of the Outcasts' intentions. This proof was delivered after a transport carrying cargo of advanced weaponry was attacked and destroyed by the Outcast Reapers of Sirius wing. The Revolutionary Council immediately declared all standing agreements between the Outcasts and Hessians as null and void. All Outcasts found within Rheinland or its border systems are to be removed from those systems. All Cardamine transports within Rheinland are now a target of opportunity. The Red Hessians will not be enslaved to drug lords, let this be a message that proves it!
1118397
[817 AS] Red Hessians Break Alliance
1118398
MALTA -- 817 AS -- After the success that our alliance with groups across the colonies brought in eradicating Corsair influence outside of the edge worlds, it seemed rather unlikely that any group would be unsatisfied with the result. And yet the Red Hessians, always blocking the flow of Cardamine into Rheinland, continued to look at us with stark suspicion and seeming disgust. Recently this disgust turned into outright hatred as the Red Hessian leadership unjustly blamed the Outcasts for an attack on one of their transports deep within the Omega systems. No Outcast pilots have or ever will operate in that area, but the Hessians will hear nothing of it. We have anticipated such a scenario a long time ago however and arrangements have been made to ensure that the Outcasts do not lose any business elsewhere as a result of this.
1118399
[817 AS] Rheinland's Military Withholds Critical Research
1118400
MANHATTAN -- 817 AS -- It has been a few months now since Rheinland has unfoundedly accused Liberty and President Powell himself of leading unsanctioned research on aliens (defined as an act forbidden by intercolonial law), an accusation that led to a large increase of tensions between the two Houses and quite likely accelerated the actual war itself.  But now it seems that the pot is actually calling the kettle black as information has been revealed by the LSF that Rheinland is stockpiling their own alien biological materials in a facility hidden deep in the Bremen system. Our heroic Navy is already preparing to put an end to this stockpile to ensure that no side in Sirius has access to any kind of weapons of mass destruction that may be gained from knowledge of such forbidden tech.

[829 AS] Colorado training exercises?
1121660
ONE POLICE PLAZA -- 829 AS -- The LPI has rerouted traffic from Colorado's New York to Denver Trade Lane, locking off that part of the system. A force spokesman confirmed that the Battleship Rio Grande had been deployed for large scale training exercises involving LPI Special Response Units. Amateur Denver cop-watchers have questioned this explanation, pointing out abnormal levels of emergency channel comm activity. Since the LPI took on the Colorado Private Security Initiative, Ageira and other local businesses have complained of worsening security, leading to a significantly higher spend on Bounty Hunters.

"Hedgehog" Missile Defense Grid
1121669
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="1" mask="1" def="-2"/><JUST loc="center"/><TEXT>WG-94 RSM Defense Grid</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0" mask="1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><PARA/><TEXT>The WG-94 Rolling Spaceframe Missile Defense Grid, colloquially known as the "Hedgehog," is an experimental weapon employed aboard the LSF Battlecruiser "Willow Grove." The complete Hedgehog system consists of a septet of launch pods taking the place of the typical small-craft defensive turrets, designed to fire the WG-94 RSM. Each missile is slaved to the TGH-77 targeting and guidance computer mounted deep within the bowels of the Battlecruiser</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The WG-94 itself is a very simple munition, consisting of little more than the shell of a CD98Rc disruptor missile with the bulky guidance computer and disruption package replaced with a miniaturized transmitter and EMP warhead. 40 rockets are contained in each quick-detach launcher, allowing for rapid restocking of the system following depletion. Designed to be controlled remotely by the mother craft, the WG-94 RSM is fast-moving and difficult to intercept or evade.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Within the Willow Grove is the TGH-77 Targeting and Guidance Handling computer. Designed to simultaneously compute trajectories and targeting information for up to 21 WG-94 missiles, the TGH requires huge amounts of power when activated. Slaved to the sensor grid of the ship, the "brainbox," as it is known, calculates optimum intercept courses and transmits the information to the missiles up until the moment of impact. This system allows for extreme miniaturization of the WG-94, without sacrificing tracking ability or payload.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Together, the "Hedgehog" is a deadly weapon against enemy bombers and fighters, stripping them of their shielding and draining powercore, while still applying modest hull damage. The project was abandoned, however, after a number of design issues became clear. The WG-94 proved woefully inadequate at damaging gunships and cruisers, and the reliance on physical ammunition prevented extended sorties into unfriendly space.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Like Jump Gates, jump holes are semi-permeable areas in real-space that have a tendency to breach the natural boundaries of linear time and space. Unlike Jump Gates, though, these anomalies occur naturally and so are both unpredictable and unstable. Traveling through jump holes is a risky proposition at best. Though some have been charted and, based on accounts from ships that have accidentally encountered them, have had their exit points logged, just as many ships have never been heard from again. It is believed that these ships were either crushed in the violent, cataclysmic vortex that lies outside the narrow corridor of a jump tunnel, or were sent to a place far enough away to make communication or a return trip infeasible. In either case, those missing are presumed dead. Ageira Technologies and Deep Space Engineering urge all citizens to use the prescribed Trade Lanes and Jump Gates and to avoid all contact with jump holes.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

It reached less than half its maxium housing capacity, and the station was notorious for a high unemployment rate and poor accommodations.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>IDF dismissed most of the crew and moved the inhabitants to temporary housing on Metz. MANHATTAN -- 830 AS -- Derek Eska, a particularly infamous criminal whom at one point in Liberty's history held significant influence in the Rogues. His legacy of rampant plundering and extortion across the House ended abruptly over two decades ago, but now it appears as if the former pack leader has resurfaced, based on a recent press conference held by the LPI regarding the sharp rise in organized crime. The Bounty Hunters Guild listings also seem to cite the long-presumed dead man as a priority target, even above others whose warrants have remained outstanding. Despite this, the authorities have issued repeated assurances that there is no cause for alarm.

1123045

1123145
[827 AS] Unknown disease causing havoc in Nu
1123146
Following a range of the local personnel falling ill after returning from the Bikini Debris Field and planet Marshall, the medical team attached to the exploration team in Omicron Nu requested the authorities to temporarily limit the traffic from and into the system and establish quarantine.  The first signs of the disease appeared soon after the planetfall on Marshall and since then the malaise spread to over 30 crew members. The cause of the illness is unknown and being researched by the medical scientists aboard "Oregon". According to the preliminary analysis, the disease is highly infectious and requires limitation of free travel in the area until the cause and/or appropriate treatment is found. One of the hypothesis blames the malaise on intensive solar flares of the three-star system and bursts of solar radiation, yet other scientists rebuke the assumption as incompetent due to the found infectious nature of the disease.  It is not the first case of xeno-disease encountered throughout the colonisation of Sirius. Many local bacteria and even viruses caused a lot of trouble for the early settlers yet have largely been subdued due to the advances in heuristic pharmacology. Cryer officials have issued a statement that a test medication is already underway and Omicron Nu restriction could be lifted soon. For now, Liberty authorities advise to avoid visiting the Omicron Nu system and remind of persecution under the Law of the Republic of Liberty in case of violation of the standing quarantine.
